authors.institution: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, China

title_en: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic pretraining for VLAs
title_zh: 先学移动，再学做事：面向VLA的任务无关预训练

sentences.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are bottlenecked by the scarcity of expert demonstrations—expensive triplets of observations, language instructions, and actions.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型受制于专家示范的稀缺——即观测、语言指令和行动的昂贵三元组。

sentences.en: We propose that learning ''how to move'' can be decoupled from learning ''what to do,'' and that the former requires no task labels at all.
sentences.zh: 我们提出，学习\"如何移动\"可以与学习\"做什么\"解耦，而且前者完全不需要任务标签。

sentences.en: Our two-stage framework, **Task-Agnostic Pretraining (TAP)** first pre-trains on abundant, cheap *task-agnostic* data (discarded off-task trajectories or autonomous robot play) using an Inverse Dynamics objective that predicts actions from consecutive observations.
sentences.zh: 我们的两阶段框架**任务无关预训练（TAP）**首先利用丰富的、廉价的*任务无关*数据（被丢弃的任务外轨迹或自主机器人嬉戏数据），使用从连续观测预测行动的逆动力学目标进行预训练。

sentences.en: This self-supervised phase instills physical affordances—grasping, contact dynamics, end-effector control—without human annotation.
sentences.zh: 这一自监督阶段在没有人工标注的情况下灌输物理可供性——抓握、接触动态、末端执行器控制。

sentences.en: A lightweight second stage then aligns these physical priors with language instructions using minimal expert data.
sentences.zh: 一个轻量级的第二阶段随后使用极小的专家数据将这些物理先验与语言指令对齐。

sentences.en: On the SIMPLER benchmark, our approach matches models trained on 1M+ expert trajectories while using orders of magnitude less labeled data, achieving a 10\% absolute gain over standard behavior cloning.
sentences.zh: 在SIMPLER基准上，我们的方法在使用的标注数据少几个数量级的情况下，媲美在100万+条专家轨迹上训练的模型，相比标准行为克隆实现了10\%的绝对增益。

sentences.en: In real-world WidowX experiments, it surpasses internet-scale baselines under visual distribution shifts (e.g., 25\% vs. 0\% under camera perturbations), demonstrating that task-agnostic pretraining yields robust, transferable physical representations for Embodied AI.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界WidowX实验中，它超越了在视觉分布偏移下（例如在相机扰动下25\%对0\%）的互联网规模基线，表明任务无关预训练能够为具身AI产生稳健、可迁移的物理表示。

title_en: Learning to Perceive the World Through Control: Empowerment-Based Representation Learning
title_zh: 通过控制学会感知世界：基于赋权（Empowerment）的表示学习

sentences.en: In many practical reinforcement learning (RL) environments, observations are far higher-dimensional than the variables that matter for control.
sentences.zh: 在许多实际的强化学习（RL）环境中，观测的维度远高于对控制重要的变量。

sentences.en: In this work, we ask: can we learn representations that capture only control-relevant features of the environment?
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出疑问：我们能否学习仅捕捉环境中与控制相关特征的表示？

sentences.en: We study this question through the \emph{empowerment} objective, which maximizes an agent’s influence over the environment and is widely used for unsupervised skill learning.
sentences.zh: 我们通过\emph{赋权}（empowerment）目标来研究这一问题，该目标最大化智能体对环境影响，并被广泛用于无监督技能学习。

sentences.en: We show that empowerment agents induce two distinct representations --- forward and backward --- that capture complementary aspects of the state, and both of which are invariant to control-irrelevant features.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，赋权智能体引出两种不同的表示——前向和后向——它们捕捉状态互补的方面，并且都对控制无关的特征不变。

sentences.en: Thus, empowerment maximization leads agents to learn an implicit, \emph{control-centric} model of the world.
sentences.zh: 因此，赋权最大化引导智能体学习一个隐式的、以*控制为中心*的世界模型。

sentences.en: Our analysis highlights the importance of learning representations through interaction rather than from passive datasets: interaction aimed at maximizing control is essential for learning useful invariance properties, a perspective that aligns closely with the causal learning literature.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析强调了通过交互而非从被动数据集学习表示的重要性：旨在最大化控制的交互对于学习有用的不变性性质至关重要，这一视角与因果学习文献紧密契合。

title_en: Learning to Rank by Directly Optimizing Full-Order Probabilities
title_zh: 通过直接优化全序概率学习排序

sentences.en: Learning to rank can be cast as a probabilistic modeling problem over permutations, where the goal is to estimate the likelihood of an observed total ordering of items.
sentences.zh: 学习排序可以表述为一个排列上的概率建模问题，其目标是估计观测到的项目全序的似然。

sentences.en: This formulation naturally involves full-order probabilities of the form $\mathbb{P}(z_1 \leq \cdots \leq z_n)$, whose exact computation and optimization are intractable due to the factorial growth of the permutation space with respect to the list size.
sentences.zh: 这种表述自然涉及形如$\mathbb{P}(z_1 \leq \cdots \leq z_n)$的全序概率，由于排列空间随列表规模呈阶乘增长，其精确计算和优化是不可行的。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce the *Full-Order Bound* (FOB), a tractable lower bound on the probability of an observed ordering, constructed from a subset of ordering constraints that factorizes across items while preserving full-order structure and order-reversal invariance.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入*全序界*（FOB），一个观测排序概率的可处理下界，由一撮在项目间因子化的排序约束子集构建，同时保留全序结构和逆序不变性。

sentences.en: Under log-concave latent densities, the bound induces a convex inner tightening problem over latent cut points, which we solve efficiently during training using a *safe-region gradient ascent* (SRGA) procedure.
sentences.zh: 在对数凹潜在密度下，该界在潜在分割点之上诱导一个凸的内收紧问题，我们在训练期间使用*safe-region梯度上升*（SRGA）过程高效求解它。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic ranking tasks and large-scale learning-to-rank benchmarks show that FOB improves full-list ordering metrics and remains competitive on NDCG, while an optional metric-aligned variant recovers NDCG gains.
sentences.zh: 在合成排序任务和大规模学习排序基准上的实验表明，FOB改进了全列表排序度量，并在NDCG上保持竞争力，而一个可选的度量对齐变体恢复了NDCG增益。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/tyxaaron/FOB.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/tyxaaron/FOB 获取。

title_en: Learning to Rank from Incomplete Rankings
title_zh: 从不完整排序中学习排序

sentences.en: In domains such as recommender systems and information retrieval, learning from human-generated feedback is especially challenging because the information provided is often sparse and incomplete.
sentences.zh: 在推荐系统和信息检索等领域，从人类生成的反馈中学习尤其具有挑战性，因为所提供的信息往往是稀疏且不完整的。

sentences.en: In this work, we address the problem of learning the top-$k$ items from incomplete rankings.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们解决从不完整排序中学习前$k$个项的问题。

sentences.en: Most existing models for incomplete rankings rely on rigid assumptions regarding both the ranking model that generates the latent ranking and the censoring mechanism that determines which comparisons remain unobserved.
sentences.zh: 大多数用于不完整排序的现有模型，对生成潜在排名的排序模型以及决定哪些比较保持未观测的删失机制，都依赖僵硬的假设。

sentences.en: On the one hand, the ranking model is often assumed to follow a Plackett-Luce (PL) or Mallows distribution.
sentences.zh: 一方面，排序模型通常被假定遵循Plackett-Luce（PL）或Mallows分布。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the censoring mechanism is typically assumed to be Missing Completely At Random (MCAR) or to exhibit well-behaved dependencies on the latent ranking, such as winner feedback or top-$h$ feedback.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，删失机制通常被假定为完全随机缺失（MCAR），或表现出对潜在排名的良好行为依赖，例如获胜者反馈或前$h$反馈。

sentences.en: We introduce a new, general framework for learning from incomplete rankings that unifies and strictly generalizes the established frameworks in the literature.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个新的、通用的从不完整排序中学习的框架，统一并严格推广了文献中既有的框架。

sentences.en: We consider the broad class of ranking models that satisfy the complete consensus property, which comprehends all widely adopted models, including PL and Mallows.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑满足完全共识性质（complete consensus property）的广泛排序模型类别，这涵盖了所有广泛采用的模型，包括PL和Mallows。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we present a new preference-based feedback model, named positional censoring, which generalizes winner and top-$h$ feedback.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出一个新的基于偏好的反馈模型，称为位置删失（positional censoring），它推广了获胜者和前$h$反馈。

sentences.en: We show that it is possible to learn in this general setting by presenting the PIRATE algorithm and providing a near-optimal instance-dependent bound to the sample complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们通过提出PIRATE算法并给出样本复杂度的接近最优的实例相关界，表明在这一通用设置下学习是可能的。

sentences.en: Finally, we show that, under the PL ranking, PIRATE matches the sample complexity of state-of-the-art algorithms in the relevant scenarios of winner and top-$h$ feedback.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们表明，在PL排序下，PIRATE在获胜者和前$h$反馈的相关场景中匹配了最先进算法的样本复杂度。

title_en: Learning to Reason for Factuality
title_zh: 学习为事实性而推理

sentences.en: Reasoning Large Language Models (R-LLMs) have significantly advanced complex reasoning tasks but often struggle with factuality, generating substantially more hallucinations than their non-reasoning counterparts on long-form factuality benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 推理大语言模型（R-LLMs）显著推进了复杂推理任务，但在事实性方面往往表现不佳，在长文事实性基准上生成的幻觉比其非推理对应物多得多。

sentences.en: However, extending online Reinforcement Learning (RL), a key component in recent R-LLM advancements, to the long-form factuality setting poses several unique challenges due to the lack of reliable verification methods.
sentences.zh: 然而，将在线强化学习（RL）——近期R-LLM进展中的一个关键组成部分——扩展到长文事实性设置，由于缺乏可靠的验证方法，会带来几个独特挑战。

sentences.en: Previous work has utilized automatic factuality evaluation frameworks such as FActScore to curate preference data in the offline RL setting, yet we find that directly leveraging such methods as the reward in online RL leads to reward hacking in multiple ways, such as producing less detailed or relevant responses.
sentences.zh: 先前的工作利用诸如FActScore之类的自动事实性评估框架，在离线RL设置中整理偏好数据，然而我们发现，在在线RL中直接利用此类方法作为奖励会以多种方式导致奖励黑客（reward hacking），例如产生更不详细或不相关的响应。

sentences.en: We propose a novel reward function that simultaneously considers the factual precision, response detail level, and answer relevance, and applies online RL to learn high quality factual reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个同时考虑事实精度、响应细节水平和答案相关性的新颖奖励函数，并应用在线RL来学习高质量的事实性推理。

sentences.en: Evaluated on six long-form factuality benchmarks, our factual reasoning model achieves an average reduction of 23.1 percentage points in hallucination rate, a 23% increase in answer detail level, and no degradation in the overall response helpfulness.
sentences.zh: 在六个长文事实性基准上的评估表明，我们的事实性推理模型将幻觉率平均降低23.1个百分点，答案细节水平提升23\%，且整体响应有用性没有退化。

title_en: Learning to Reconfigure: Configuration-Control Co-optimization of Reconfigurable Robots for Heterogeneous Locomotion
title_zh: 学会重构：面向异构运动的可重构机器人配置-控制协同优化

sentences.en: Traditional robot co-design approaches typically converge to one configuration, which do not explore the flexibility from reconfiguration on heterogeneous environments.
sentences.zh: 传统的机器人协同设计方法通常收敛到一种配置，没有探索在异构环境上重构带来的灵活性。

sentences.en: On the other hand, existing designs for reconfigurable robots require human-designed configurations.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，现有的可重构机器人设计需要人工设计的配置。

sentences.en: We present Learning to Reconfigure, a holistic pipeline for configuration-control co-optimization of reconfigurable robots in heterogeneous locomotion tasks consisting of several sub-tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们提出学会重构（Learning to Reconfigure），一个用于可重构机器人在异构运动任务（由多个子任务组成）中配置-控制协同优化的整体流水线。

sentences.en: Our pipeline proposes low-level specialized primitives with a high-level scheduler.
sentences.zh: 我们的流水线提出了底层的专用原语以及一个高层调度器。

sentences.en: To jointly optimize configuration design and control, our primitives employ a multi-tail architecture that disentangles these distinct objectives.
sentences.zh: 为联合优化配置设计与控制，我们的原语采用一种多尾架构，将这些不同目标解缠开来。

sentences.en: Building on this, the scheduler learns to dynamically switch configurations based on global task progress.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，调度器学会基于全局任务进度动态切换配置。

sentences.en: We evaluate our pipeline on locomotion tasks across walking, flying, and swimming, and compare with the state-of-the-art baselines, including single-robot control and multi-morphology co-optimization algorithms.
sentences.zh: 我们在行走、飞行和游泳等运动任务上评估我们的流水线，并与最先进基线（包括单机器人控制和多形态协同优化算法）进行比较。

sentences.en: Quantitative results based on traversal progress show that our pipeline outperforms single-robot baselines by 5.95x average progress.
sentences.zh: 基于穿越进度的定量结果表明，我们的流水线平均进度达到单机器人基线的5.95倍。

sentences.en: Compared with the reconfiguration-free design given by the co-design algorithms, our robots also exhibit 9.81x progress on average.
sentences.zh: 与协同设计算法给出的无重构设计相比，我们的机器人平均进度也达到9.81倍。

sentences.en: These results highlight the critical role of configuration adaptation in achieving versatile robotic autonomy in complex worlds.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了配置自适应在复杂世界中实现多功能机器人自主性的关键作用。

title_en: Learning to Refine: Spectral-Decoupled Iterative Refinement Framework for Precipitation Nowcasting
title_zh: 学会细化：用于降水临近预报的谱解耦迭代细化框架

sentences.en: Accurate precipitation nowcasting is vital for disaster mitigation, but deep learning methods face a key trade-off: regression models produce over-smoothed, spectrally decaying predictions that blur convective details and violate turbulence power laws; diffusion models generate realistic yet unanchored hallucinations lacking physical grounding.
sentences.zh: 准确的降水临近预报对减轻灾害至关重要，但深度学习方法面临一个关键权衡：回归模型产生过度平滑、谱衰减的预测，模糊了对流细节并违反湍流幂律；扩散模型生成逼真但无锚定的幻觉，缺乏物理接地。

sentences.en: We propose Spectral-Decoupled Iterative Refinement (SDIR), a deterministic framework that reformulates nowcasting as progressive frequency-decoupled refinement.
sentences.zh: 我们提出谱解耦迭代细化（SDIR），一个确定性框架，将临近预报重新表述为渐进的频率解耦细化。

sentences.en: SDIR first extracts a stable low-frequency synoptic skeleton, then iteratively refines high-frequency textures under physical constraints, eliminating both blurring and hallucinations.
sentences.zh: SDIR首先提取稳定的低频天气尺（synoptic）骨架，然后在物理约束下迭代细化高频纹理，同时消除模糊和幻觉。

sentences.en: It features a dual-path design: the Synoptic Frequency-Guided Former (SFG-Former) with Scale-Adaptive Transformers for global structure, and the Fourier Residual Refiner (FR-Refiner) with Scale-Conditioned Fourier Neural Operators for fine residuals.
sentences.zh: 它具有双路径设计：用于全局结构的带尺度自适应Transformer的天气尺频率引导Former（SFG-Former），以及用于精细残差的带尺度条件Fourier神经算子的Fourier残差细化器（FR-Refiner）。

sentences.en: A Physically Consistent Power Spectral Density (PCPSD) loss with dynamic masking enforces a turbulence-consistent spectral distribution.
sentences.zh: 一个带动态掩码的物理一致功率谱密度（PCPSD）损失强制实现与湍流一致的谱分布。

sentences.en: Experiments on three benchmarks show SDIR significantly outperforms SOTA methods in spatial accuracy while achieving spectral fidelity competitive with diffusion-based methods, enabling reliable high-resolution operational nowcasting.
sentences.zh: 在三个基准上的实验表明，SDIR在空间精度上显著优于SOTA方法，同时达到了与基于扩散的方法相当的谱保真度，从而实现了可靠的高分辨率业务化临近预报。

sentences.en: Code link: https://github.com/RuntimeWarning/SDIR.
sentences.zh: 代码链接：https://github.com/RuntimeWarning/SDIR。

title_en: Learning to Remember, Learn, and Forget in Attention-Based Models
title_zh: 在基于注意力的模型中学会记忆、学习与遗忘

sentences.en: In-Context Learning (ICL) in transformers acts as an online associative memory and is believed to underpin their high performance on complex sequence processing tasks.
sentences.zh: Transformer中的上下文学习（ICL）充当在线联想记忆，被认为支撑了它们在复杂序列处理任务上的高性能。

sentences.en: However, in gated linear attention models, this memory has a fixed capacity and is prone to interference, especially for long sequences.
sentences.zh: 然而，在门控线性注意力模型中，这种记忆容量固定，并且容易受到干扰，尤其是对于长序列。

sentences.en: We propose Palimpsa, a self-attention model that views ICL as a continual learning problem that must address a stability-plasticity dilemma.
sentences.zh: 我们提出Palimpsa，一个将ICL视为必须解决稳定性-可塑性困境的持续学习问题的自注意力模型。

sentences.en: Palimpsa uses Bayesian metaplasticity, where the plasticity of each attention state is tied to an importance state grounded by a prior distribution that captures accumulated knowledge.
sentences.zh: Palimpsa使用贝叶斯元可塑性，其中每个注意力状态的可塑性与一个重要性状态绑定，并由一个捕捉累积知识的先验分布接地。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that various gated linear attention models emerge as specific architecture choices and posterior approximations, and that Mamba2 is a special case of Palimpsa where forgetting dominates.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，各种门控线性注意力模型可以作为特定的架构选择和后验近似而出现，并且Mamba2是遗忘占主导的Palimpsa的一个特例。

sentences.en: This theoretical link enables the transformation of any non-metaplastic model into a metaplastic one, significantly expanding its memory capacity.
sentences.zh: 这一理论联系使得任何非元可塑性模型都能转化为元可塑性模型，显著扩大其记忆容量。

sentences.en: Our experiments show that Palimpsa consistently outperforms baselines on the Multi-Query Associative Recall (MQAR) benchmark and on Commonsense Reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，在Multi-Query联想召回（MQAR）基准和常识推理任务上，Palimpsa始终优于基线。

title_en: Learning to Route Languages for Multilingual Policy Optimization
title_zh: 为多语言策略优化学习语言路由

sentences.en: Large language models~(LLMs) are trained on heterogeneous multilingual corpora, yet existing policy optimization methods often implicitly restrict each training question to a single response language or rely on a fixed dominant language for supervision.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）在异构的多语言语料库上训练，然而现有的策略优化方法往往隐式地将每个训练问题限制为单一响应语言，或依赖固定的主导语言进行监督。

sentences.en: We propose language-routed policy optimization (LRPO), an online reinforcement learning framework that treats language as a selectable variable.
sentences.zh: 我们提出语言路由策略优化（LRPO），一个将语言视为可选择性变量的在线强化学习框架。

sentences.en: LRPO elicits multilingual rollouts for each training question and integrates their relative quality into preference-based policy updates, increasing the diversity and informativeness of training signals under the fixed rollout budget.
sentences.zh: LRPO为每个训练问题引出多语言展开（rollouts），并将其相对质量整合到基于偏好的策略更新中，从而在固定展开预算下增加训练信号的多样性和信息量。

sentences.en: To adaptively determine which languages to explore during reinforcement learning, we introduce a trainable language router formulated as a multi-armed bandit, balancing exploration of underutilized languages with exploitation of more informative ones.
sentences.zh: 为在强化学习期间自适应地决定探索哪些语言，我们引入一个表述为多臂赌博机的可训练语言路由器，在探索未被充分利用的语言与利用更具信息性的语言之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that LRPO consistently improves multilingual performance, demonstrating that adaptive language routing enables effective cross-lingual knowledge exploitation for training.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，LRPO持续提升多语言性能，证明自适应语言路由能够为训练实现有效的跨语言知识利用。

sentences.en: We release all the resources at \url{https://github.com/Guochry/LRPO}.
sentences.zh: 我们在\url{https://github.com/Guochry/LRPO}发布所有资源。

title_en: Learning to Search and Searching to Learn for Generalization in Planning
title_zh: 学习搜索与搜索以学习：实现规划中的泛化

sentences.en: Combinatorial generalization remains a central challenge in Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL).
sentences.zh: 组合泛化仍然是深度强化学习（DRL）中的核心挑战。

sentences.en: Classical planning provides a simple yet challenging setting to study this problem through explicit relational descriptions, without requiring learning from perception.
sentences.zh: 经典规划通过显式的关系描述为研究这一问题提供了一个简单而具有挑战性的设置，无需从感知中学习。

sentences.en: In sparse-reward domains, standard RL exploration via real-time search is ineffective, and learning-based planning methods often rely on expert demonstrations, hindsight relabeling, or random walks from the goal state.
sentences.zh: 在稀疏奖励领域中，通过实时搜索的标准RL探索是低效的，而基于学习的规划方法往往依赖专家示范、事后重标记（hindsight relabeling）或从目标状态出发的随机游走。

sentences.en: In contrast, planners rely on best-first search methods such as $\mathrm{A}^\star$ to solve problems from scratch.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，规划器依赖诸如$\mathrm{A}^\star$之类的最佳优先搜索方法从头解决问题。

sentences.en: We propose a self-improving $\mathrm{WA}^\star$ learning framework in combination with a value heuristic represented by a Relational Graph Neural Network: the heuristic guides search, and the resulting search data updates the heuristic via $Q$-learning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个自改进的$\mathrm{WA}^\star$学习框架，并结合由关系图神经网络表示的启发式值函数：启发式引导搜索，而由此得到的搜索数据通过$Q$-学习更新启发式。

sentences.en: This loop yields heuristics that can function as general policies and solve new instances even without search, where DRL otherwise fails, as we show on puzzles such as Sokoban, PushWorld, The Witness, and the 2023 International Planning Competition benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 这一循环产生的启发式可以充当通用策略，甚至在无需搜索的情况下也能解决新实例（而DRL在此处会失败），正如我们在Sokoban、PushWorld、The Witness和2023年国际规划竞赛基准等难题上所示范的那样。

sentences.en: Notably, we demonstrate strong zero-shot generalization: For example, heuristics trained on Blocksworld instances with fewer than $30$ blocks successfully solve instances with $488$ blocks without search.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们展示了强大的零样本泛化：例如，在少于$30$个积木的Blocksworld实例上训练的启发式，无需搜索即可成功解决具有$488$个积木的实例。

title_en: Learning to Self-Verify Makes Language Models Better Reasoners
title_zh: 学习自我验证使语言模型成为更好的推理者

sentences.en: Recent large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance in generating promising reasoning paths for complex tasks.
sentences.zh: 近期的大语言模型（LLMs）在为复杂任务生成有前景的推理路径方面取得了强劲性能。

sentences.en: However, despite powerful generation ability, LLMs remain weak at verifying their own answers, revealing a persistent capability asymmetry between generation and self-verification.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管拥有强大的生成能力，LLMs在验证自身答案方面仍然薄弱，揭示了生成与自我验证之间持续存在的能力不对称性。

sentences.en: In this work, we conduct an in-depth investigation of this asymmetry throughout training evolution and show that, even on the same task, improving generation does not lead to corresponding improvements in self-verification.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们对这种不对称性在整个训练演变过程中的表现进行了深入调查，并表明，即使在相同任务上，改进生成也不会带来自我验证的相应改进。

sentences.en: Interestingly, we find that the reverse direction of this asymmetry behaves differently: learning to self-verify can effectively improve generation performance, achieving accuracy comparable to standard generation training while yielding more efficient and effective reasoning traces.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我们发现这种不对称性的反向方向表现不同：学习自我验证可以有效提升生成性能，达到与标准生成训练相当的准确率，同时产生更高效、更有效的推理痕迹。

sentences.en: Building on this observation, we further explore integrating self-verification into generation training by formulating a multi-task reinforcement learning framework, where generation and self-verification are optimized as two independent but complementary objectives.
sentences.zh: 基于这一观察，我们进一步探索通过构建一个多任务强化学习框架，将自我验证整合到生成训练中，其中生成与自我验证被优化为两个独立但互补的目标。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across benchmarks and models demonstrate performance gains over generation-only training in both generation and verification capabilities.
sentences.zh: 跨越基准和模型的大量实验表明，在生成和验证能力方面，相较于仅生成训练都有性能提升。

title_en: Learning to Share: Selective Memory for Efficient Parallel Agentic Systems
title_zh: 学会共享：面向高效并行智能体系统的选择性记忆

sentences.en: Agentic systems solve complex tasks by coordinating multiple agents that iteratively reason, invoke tools, and exchange intermediate results.
sentences.zh: 智能体系统通过协调多个智能体来解决复杂任务，这些智能体反复推理、调用工具并交换中间结果。

sentences.en: To improve robustness and solution quality, recent approaches deploy multiple agent teams running in parallel to explore diverse reasoning trajectories.
sentences.zh: 为提升鲁棒性和解的质量，近期的做法部署多个并行运行的智能体团队，以探索多样化的推理轨迹。

sentences.en: However, parallel execution comes at a significant computational cost: when different teams independently reason about similar sub-problems or execute analogous steps, they repeatedly perform substantial overlapping computation.
sentences.zh: 然而，并行执行带来了显著的计算成本：当不同团队独立地推理相似的子问题或执行类似的步骤时，它们会反复进行大量重叠的计算。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, in this paper, we propose Learning to Share (LTS), a learned shared-memory mechanism for parallel agentic frameworks that enables selective cross-team information reuse while controlling context growth.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，在本文中我们提出学会共享（LTS），一种用于并行智能体框架的学习式共享记忆机制，在控制上下文增长的同时，实现选择性的跨团队信息重用。

sentences.en: LTS introduces a global memory bank accessible to all teams and a lightweight controller that decides whether intermediate agent steps should be added to memory or not.
sentences.zh: LTS引入一个所有团队都可访问的全局记忆库，以及一个决定中间智能体步骤是否应被加入记忆的轻量级控制器。

sentences.en: The controller is trained using stepwise reinforcement learning with usage-aware credit assignment, allowing it to identify information that is globally useful across parallel executions.
sentences.zh: 该控制器使用带使用感知信用分配的逐步强化学习进行训练，使其能够识别在并行执行中全局有用的信息。

sentences.en: Experiments on the AssistantBench and GAIA benchmarks show that LTS significantly reduces overall runtime while matching or improving task performance compared to memory-free parallel baselines, demonstrating that learned memory admission is an effective strategy for improving the efficiency of parallel agentic systems.
sentences.zh: 在AssistantBench和GAIA基准上的实验表明，与无记忆并行基线相比，LTS显著降低整体运行时间，同时匹配或提升任务性能，证明学习式记忆准入是提升并行智能体系统效率的有效策略。

title_en: Learning to Theorize the World from Observation
title_zh: 从观察中学会构建世界理论

sentences.en: What does it mean to understand the world?
sentences.zh: 理解世界意味着什么？

sentences.en: Is it simply to predict future video frames?
sentences.zh: 仅仅是对未来视频帧的预测吗？

sentences.en: Developmental cognitive science suggests that understanding the world is fundamentally the process of constructing internal theories of how it works rather than mere prediction, even before language is acquired.
sentences.zh: 发展认知科学表明，理解世界从根本上说是构建其如何运作的内部理论的过程，而非仅仅预测，即使在习得语言之前也是如此。

sentences.en: However, in machine learning, it remains unclear how to endow AI systems with such theory-building capability from raw, non-textual observation alone.
sentences.zh: 然而，在机器学习中，如何仅从原始的、非文本的观察赋予AI系统这种构建理论的能力仍不明确。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce Learning-to-Theorize (L2T), a learning paradigm in which an AI system acquires the ability to construct theories represented as executable programs directly from observation alone.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们引入学会构建理论（L2T），一种学习范式，使AI系统能够仅从观察中就获得构建以可执行程序形式表示的理论的能力。

sentences.en: To instantiate this paradigm, we propose the Neural Language-of-Thought Programmer, a neural model that induces and executes latent programs as explanations rather than task-specific predictors or policies.
sentences.zh: 为实例化这种范式，我们提出神经思想语言程序员，一种诱导并执行潜在程序作为解释（而非任务特定的预测器或策略）的神经模型。

sentences.en: In experiments, we show that this formulation enables explanation-driven generalization, allowing observations to be understood in terms of the programs that generate them.
sentences.zh: 在实验中，我们表明这种表述能够实现解释驱动的泛化，使观测能够根据产生它们的程序被理解。

title_en: Learning to Think in Physics: Breaking Shortcut Learning in Scientific Diffusion via Representation Alignment
title_zh: 学会在物理中思考：通过表示对齐打破科学扩散中的捷径学习

sentences.en: Physics-informed diffusion models typically enforce PDE constraints only on final outputs, leaving intermediate representations unconstrained and prone to shortcut learning under shifted boundary conditions.
sentences.zh: 物理信息扩散模型通常仅在最终输出上强制施加PDE约束，使中间表示不受约束，并在移位的边界条件下容易产生捷径学习。

sentences.en: We introduce **REPA-P**, a teacher-free, architecture-agnostic framework that aligns intermediate features with physical states using first-principles residuals.
sentences.zh: 我们引入**REPA-P**，一个无教师、架构无关的框架，使用第一性原理残差将中间特征与物理状态对齐。

sentences.en: REPA-P attaches lightweight $1{\times}1$ projection heads to selected layers, decodes hidden activations into physical quantities, and applies PDE residual losses during training.
sentences.zh: REPA-P将轻量级的$1{\times}1$投影头附加到选定的层上，将隐藏激活解码为物理量，并在训练期间施加PDE残差损失。

sentences.en: These heads are discarded at inference, introducing **zero overhead**.
sentences.zh: 这些头在推理时被丢弃，引入**零开销**。

sentences.en: Across four PDE tasks, including Darcy flow, topology optimization, electrostatic potential, and turbulent channel flow, REPA-P accelerates convergence by up to $2{\times}$, reduces physics residuals by up to $66.4\%$, and improves out-of-distribution robustness by up to $49.3\%$, with consistent gains on both U-Net and Diffusion Transformer backbones.
sentences.zh: 在四个PDE任务（包括Darcy流、拓扑优化、静电势和湍流沟道流）中，REPA-P将收敛加速最高$2\times$倍，物理残差最高降低66.4\%，分布外鲁棒性最高提升49.3\%，且在U-Net和扩散Transformer两种骨干上都有一致的增益。

sentences.en: Ablations show that supervising a small set of intermediate layers captures most benefits and complements output-level physics losses.
sentences.zh: 消融研究表明，监督少量中间层即可获得大部分收益，并补充输出级物理损失。

sentences.en: Code is available at [https://github.com/Hxxxz0/REPA-P](https://github.com/Hxxxz0/REPA-P).
sentences.zh: 代码见 [https://github.com/Hxxxz0/REPA-P](https://github.com/Hxxxz0/REPA-P)。

title_en: Learning to Watch: Active Video Anomaly Understanding via Interleaved Policy Optimization
title_zh: 学会观看：通过交错策略优化实现主动视频异常理解

sentences.en: Video anomaly understanding (VAU) relies on sparse, context-dependent cues.
sentences.zh: 视频异常理解（VAU）依赖于稀疏的、与上下文相关的线索。

sentences.en: However, existing passive paradigms suffer from observational aliasing, where static sampling fails to disambiguate semantically distinct events.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的被动范式受观测混淆（observational aliasing）之害，即静态采样无法消解语义截然不同的事件。

sentences.en: To overcome this, we propose $Anom\text{-}\pi$, a closed-loop framework that reconceptualizes video understanding as an active sequential decision-making process within a dynamic environment.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一问题，我们提出$Anom\text{-}\pi$，一个将视频理解重新构想为动态环境中主动序贯决策过程的闭环框架。

sentences.en: Inspired by human video-reviewing behavior, this framework unifies internal cognitive reasoning and strategic evidence acquisition into an interleaved policy, utilizing temporal atomic operators such as local backtracking, temporal expansion, and fine-grained sampling to endow the model with perceptual proactivity.
sentences.zh: 受人类视频审阅行为的启发，该框架将内部认知推理与策略性证据获取统一到一条交错策略中，利用局部回溯、时间扩展和细粒度采样等时间原子算子，赋予模型感知主动性。

sentences.en: To learn such complex interaction strategies under video-level weak supervision, we design Interactive Direct Preference Optimization (iDPO) to achieve trajectory-level policy alignment, guided by an Active Evidence Inquiry (AEI) utility that balances task success, informative evidence acquisition, and interaction cost.
sentences.zh: 为在视频级弱监督下学习这种复杂的交互策略，我们设计交互式直接偏好优化（iDPO），以实现轨迹级策略对齐，并由一个平衡任务成功、信息性证据获取和交互成本的主动证据询问（AEI）效用所引导。

sentences.en: This approach enables the agent to learn to actively disambiguate hypotheses while suppressing redundant exploration.
sentences.zh: 这种方法使智能体能够学会主动消解假设，同时抑制冗余探索。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework, with only 2B parameters, achieves highly competitive performance, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art large-scale VAU models in complex scenarios.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的框架仅用2B参数就取得了极具竞争力的性能，在复杂场景中显著优于最先进的大规模VAU模型。

title_en: Learning to Watermark in the Latent Space of Generative Models
title_zh: 在生成式模型的潜在空间中学习水印

sentences.en: Existing approaches for watermarking AI-generated images often rely on post-hoc methods applied in pixel space, introducing computational overhead and potential visual artifacts.
sentences.zh: 现有的AI生成图像水印方法往往依赖在像素空间中应用的事后方法，这会带来计算开销和潜在的视觉伪影。

sentences.en: In this work, we explore latent space watermarking and introduce DistSeal, a unified approach for latent watermarking that works across both diffusion and autoregressive models.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们探索潜在空间水印，并引入DistSeal，一种在扩散和自回归模型上均适用的统一潜在水印方法。

sentences.en: Our approach works by training post-hoc watermarking models in the latent space of generative models.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法通过在生成式模型的潜在空间中训练事后水印模型来工作。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that these latent watermarkers can be effectively distilled either into the generative model itself or into the latent decoder, enabling in-model watermarking.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，这些潜在水印器可以被有效地蒸馏到生成模型本身或潜在解码器中，从而实现模型内水印。

sentences.en: The resulting latent watermarks achieve competitive robustness while offering similar imperceptibility and up to 20x speedup compared to pixel-space baselines.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的潜在水印实现了具有竞争力的鲁棒性，同时提供类似的不可感知性，与像素空间基线相比加速高达20倍。

sentences.en: Our experiments further reveal that distilling latent watermarkers outperforms distilling pixel-space ones, providing a solution that is both more efficient and more robust.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验进一步揭示，蒸馏潜在水印器优于蒸馏像素空间水印器，提供了一种既更高效又更稳健的解决方案。

title_en: Learning Transferable Interaction Primitives from Game Videos for Humanoid Locomotion
title_zh: 从游戏视频学习可迁移的交互原语用于人形机器人运动

sentences.en: Learning humanoid control from video provides a scalable alternative to the scarcity of high-fidelity robot data.
sentences.zh: 从视频学习人形机器人控制，为高保真机器人数据的稀缺性提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。

sentences.en: Existing methods, however, often rely on curated datasets and treat video as passive kinematic priors.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法往往依赖经过整理的数据集，并将视频视为被动的运动学先验。

sentences.en: They fail to capture dynamic humanoid interactions with the environment, which are essential for robust control in complex physical environments.
sentences.zh: 它们无法捕捉人形机器人与环境的动态交互，而这对于复杂物理环境中的稳健控制至关重要。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose ***TR**ansferable **I**nteraction **P**rimitives (TRIP)*, a framework designed to extract and ground interactions from unlabeled game videos for locomotion control.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出***TR**ansferable **I**nteraction **P**rimitives（TRIP，可迁移交互原语）*，一个旨在从未标注的游戏视频中提取并锚定交互以用于运动控制的框架。

sentences.en: TRIP explicitly models dependencies between motion dynamics and environmental context via a discrete library of interaction-based action primitives.
sentences.zh: TRIP通过一个基于交互的动作原语离散库，显式建模运动动态与环境上下文之间的依赖关系。

sentences.en: To bridge the reality gap, we introduce a shared context latent space that aligns implicit video-domain features with functional target-domain observations, enabling the seamless transfer of video-mined strategies to reinforcement learning policies.
sentences.zh: 为弥合现实差距，我们引入一个共享的上下文潜在空间，将隐式的视频域特征与功能性的目标域观测对齐，使从视频中挖掘的策略能够无缝迁移到强化学习策略。

sentences.en: Our experiments on complex terrain navigation demonstrate that TRIP achieves significant improvements in task performance, sample efficiency, and robustness.
sentences.zh: 我们在复杂地形导航上的实验表明，TRIP在任务性能、样本效率和鲁棒性方面取得了显著改进。

title_en: Learning Treatment Allocations with Risk Control Under Partial Identifiability
title_zh: 部分可识别情况下带风险控制的治疗分配学习

sentences.en: Learning beneficial treatment allocations for a patient population is an important problem in precision medicine.
sentences.zh: 为患者群体学习有益的治疗分配是精准医学中的一个重要问题。

sentences.en: For such allocations, a certain proportion of treated patients may not receive any benefit.
sentences.zh: 对于此类分配，一定比例的接受治疗的患者可能不会获得任何益处。

sentences.en: This proportion of unnecessary treated represents a `treatment risk' which is a waste of resources and may, in addition, expose patients to unnecessary adverse effects.
sentences.zh: 这一不必要治疗的比例代表\"治疗风险\"，是对资源的浪费，并且还可能使患者暴露于不必要的副作用之下。

sentences.en: Therefore, we aim to  control the treatment risk when learning beneficial allocations.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的目标是在学习有益分配时控制治疗风险。

sentences.en: This  learning problem is complicated by the fact that the treatment risk is generally not identifiable from either randomized trial or observational data.
sentences.zh: 这一学习问题因治疗风险通常无法从随机试验或观测数据中识别而变得复杂。

sentences.en: We propose a certifiable learning method that controls treatment risk, using finite samples in the partially identified setting.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种可认证的学习方法，在部分识别设置下使用有限样本控制治疗风险。

sentences.en: The method is illustrated using both simulated and real data.
sentences.zh: 该方法通过模拟和真实数据进行说明。

title_en: Learning Treatment Representations for Downstream Instrumental Variable Regression
title_zh: 为下游工具变量回归学习治疗表示

sentences.en: Traditional instrumental variable (IV) estimators cannot accommodate more treatments than instruments, a limitation that is critical for high-dimensional, unstructured data like clinical treatment pathways.
sentences.zh: 传统的工具变量（IV）估计器无法容纳治疗数量多于工具数量的情况，这一局限对于诸如临床治疗途径之类的高维、非结构化数据至关重要。

sentences.en: Current practice—applying unsupervised dimension reduction before IV estimation—suffers from substantial omitted treatment bias because the representation learning step ignores the instrument.
sentences.zh: 当前的做法——在IV估计之前应用无监督降维——因表示学习步骤忽略了工具而遭受严重的遗漏治疗偏差。

sentences.en: We propose a novel framework that constructs treatment representations by explicitly incorporating instrumental variables.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个新框架，通过显式纳入工具变量来构建治疗表示。

sentences.en: We prove that this instrument-guided approach ensures the identification of optimal outcome-prediction directions even with limited instruments.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，即使工具有限，这种工具引导的方法也能确保最优结果预测方向的识别。

sentences.en: Validation on large-scale, semi-synthetic clinical data derived from a major hospital, along with other simulations, shows that our approach significantly outperforms conventional two-stage methods.
sentences.zh: 在源自一家大型医院的大规模半合成临床数据以及其他模拟上的验证表明，我们的方法显著优于传统的两阶段方法。

title_en: Learning Unanimously Acceptable Lotteries via Queries
title_zh: 通过查询学习全票接受的抽彩

sentences.en: Many high-stakes AI deployments proceed only if every stakeholder deems the system acceptable relative to their own minimum standard.
sentences.zh: 许多高风险的AI部署只有在每位利益相关者都认为系统相对于其自身的最低标准是可以接受的时才会进行。

sentences.en: With randomization over a finite menu of options, this becomes a feasibility question: does there exist a lottery over options that clears all stakeholders' acceptability bars?
sentences.zh: 通过在有限选项菜单上进行随机化，这就变成了一个可行性问题：是否存在一个能通过所有利益相关者接受门槛的选项抽彩？

sentences.en: We study a query model where the algorithm proposes lotteries and receives only binary accept/reject feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们研究一种查询模型，其中算法提出抽彩，并仅接收二元的接受/拒绝反馈。

sentences.en: We give deterministic and randomized algorithms that either find a unanimously acceptable lottery or certify infeasibility; adaptivity can avoid eliciting many stakeholders' constraints, and randomization further reduces the expected elicitation cost relative to full elicitation.
sentences.zh: 我们给出确定性和随机化算法，它们要么找到一个全票接受的抽彩，要么证明不可行；自适应可以避免询问许多利益相关者的约束，而随机化进一步降低了相对于完整询问的期望询问成本。

sentences.en: We complement these upper bounds with worst-case lower bounds (in particular, linear dependence on the number of stakeholders and logarithmic dependence on precision are unavoidable).
sentences.zh: 我们以最坏情况下的下界对这些上界进行补充（特别是，对利益相关者数量的线性依赖和对精度的对数依赖是不可避免的）。

sentences.en: Finally, we develop learning-augmented algorithms that exploit natural forms of advice (e.g., likely binding stakeholders or a promising lottery), improving query complexity when predictions are accurate while preserving worst-case guarantees.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们开发学习增强算法，利用自然形式的建议（例如，可能具有约束力的利益相关者或有前景的抽彩），在预测准确时改善查询复杂度，同时保留最坏情况保证。

title_en: Learning Unmasking Policies for Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 学习扩散语言模型的去掩码策略

sentences.en: Diffusion (Large)
sentences.zh: 扩散（大型）

sentences.en: Language Models (dLLMs) now match the downstream performance of their autoregressive counterparts on many tasks, while holding the promise of being more efficient during inference.
sentences.zh: 语言模型（dLLMs）如今在许多任务上与自回归对应物的下游性能相当，同时有望在推理期间更加高效。

sentences.en: One critical design aspect of dLLMs is the \textit{sampling procedure} that selects which tokens to unmask at each diffusion step.
sentences.zh: dLLM的一个关键设计方面是\textit{采样过程}，它选择在每个扩散步骤中要对哪些令牌进行去掩码。

sentences.en: Indeed, recent work has found that heuristic strategies such as confidence thresholding improve both sample quality and token throughput compared to random unmasking.
sentences.zh: 事实上，近期工作发现，与随机去掩码相比，置信度阈值化等启发式策略能同时提升样本质量和令牌吞吐量。

sentences.en: However, such heuristics have downsides: they require manual tuning, and we observe that their performance degrades with larger block sizes.
sentences.zh: 然而，此类启发式有缺点：它们需要手动调参，并且我们观察到它们的性能随较大块大小而下降。

sentences.en: In this work, we instead propose to train sampling procedures using reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们转而提出使用强化学习来训练采样过程。

sentences.en: Specifically, we formalize masked diffusion sampling as a Markov decision process in which the dLLM serves as the environment, and propose a lightweight policy based on a single-layer transformer that maps dLLM token confidences to unmasking decisions.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们将掩码扩散采样形式化为一个马尔可夫决策过程，其中dLLM充当环境，并提出一个基于单层Transformer的轻量级策略，将dLLM令牌置信度映射为去掩码决策。

sentences.en: Our experiments show that these trained policies match the performance of state-of-the-art heuristics when combined with semi-autoregressive (block) generation, while outperforming them in the full-diffusion setting.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，当与半自回归（块）生成结合时，这些训练后的策略能与最先进启发式的性能相当，而在全扩散设置中则优于它们。

title_en: Learning What to Generate: A Reinforcement Learning-based Closed-Loop Augmentation Framework for Person Re-identification
title_zh: 学习生成什么：一种基于强化学习的闭环数据增强框架用于行人重识别

sentences.en: Person re-identification (ReID) models are sensitive to long-tail nuisances (e.g., rare viewpoints, occlusions, complex backgrounds), yet current generative augmentation is largely open-loop: prompts/conditions are sampled heuristically without verifying whether the synthesized samples improve ReID discriminability.
sentences.zh: 行人重识别（ReID）模型对长尾干扰因素（例如罕见的视角、遮挡、复杂背景）非常敏感，然而当前的生成式数据增强大多是开环的：提示/条件通过启发式方法采样，而没有验证合成样本是否能提升ReID的判别能力。

sentences.en: We introduce ReasonAug, a closed-loop framework that learns an image-conditioned instruction policy for a frozen generator, turning augmentation into a sequential decision problem over instruction tokens.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了ReasonAug，这是一个闭环框架，为冻结的生成器学习一种以图像为条件的指令策略，将数据增强转化为关于指令token的序列决策问题。

sentences.en: A Semantic Reasoning Agent (SRA) performs hierarchical planning from global semantics to identity-critical local cues, producing structured edit instructions whose utility is verified by downstream ReID feedback.
sentences.zh: 语义推理智能体（SRA）执行从全局语义到身份关键局部线索的分层规划，生成结构化编辑指令，其效用通过下游ReID反馈进行验证。

sentences.en: To make closed-loop optimization reliable, we propose Metric-Aligned Gated Reward (MAGR), which converts metric-learning objectives into a dense reward while gating task shaping by identity preservation to prevent reward hacking, and Structure-Aware Entropy (SAE), which allocates exploration per token to lock identity-critical cues while diversifying nuisance factors.
sentences.zh: 为了使闭环优化可靠，我们提出了度量对齐门控奖励（MAGR），它将度量学习目标转化为稠密奖励，同时通过身份保持对任务塑造进行门控以防止奖励欺骗；以及结构感知熵（SAE），它为每个token分配探索量，以锁定身份关键线索同时使干扰因素多样化。

sentences.en: Experiments on Market-1501 and MSMT17 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, confirming that closing the augmentation loop and learning what to generate yield more discriminative training data than open-loop alternatives.
sentences.zh: 在Market-1501和MSMT17上的实验展示了最先进的性能，证实了闭环数据增强和学习生成什么比开环方法能产生更具判别性的训练数据。

title_en: Learning When to Act or Refuse: Guarding Agentic Reasoning Models for Safe Multi-Step Tool Use
title_zh: 学习何时行动或拒绝：守护智能体推理模型以实现安全的多步骤工具使用

sentences.en: Agentic language models operate in a fundamentally different safety regime than chat models: they must plan, call tools, and execute long-horizon actions where a single misstep, such as accessing files or entering credentials, can cause irreversible harm.
sentences.zh: 智能体语言模型运行在与聊天模型根本不同的安全机制下：它们必须规划、调用工具并执行长视界行动，其中任何一个失误（例如访问文件或输入凭据）都可能造成不可逆的伤害。

sentences.en: Existing alignment methods, largely optimized for static generation and task completion, break down in these settings due to sequential decision-making, adversarial tool feedback, and overconfident intermediate reasoning.
sentences.zh: 现有的对齐方法大多针对静态生成和任务完成进行优化，由于序列决策、对抗性工具反馈以及过度自信的中间推理，这些方法在这些场景中会失效。

sentences.en: We introduce MOSAIC, a post-training framework that aligns agents for safe multi-step tool use by making safety decisions explicit and learnable.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了MOSAIC，一个后训练框架，通过将安全决策变得显式且可学习，来实现智能体安全的多步骤工具使用对齐。

sentences.en: MOSAIC structures inference as a plan, check, then act or refuse loop, with explicit safety reasoning and refusal as first-class actions.
sentences.zh: MOSAIC将推理构建为“规划、检查、然后行动或拒绝”的循环，并将显式安全推理和拒绝作为一流的动作。

sentences.en: To train without trajectory-level labels, we use preference-based reinforcement learning with pairwise trajectory comparisons, which captures safety distinctions often missed by scalar rewards.
sentences.zh: 为了在没有轨迹级标签的情况下训练，我们使用基于偏好的强化学习，结合成对轨迹比较，能够捕捉标量奖励经常忽略的安全差异。

sentences.en: We evaluate MOSAIC zero-shot across three model families, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-4B-Thinking, Phi-4 and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking, and across out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning harmful tasks, prompt injection, benign tool use, and cross-domain privacy leakage.
sentences.zh: 我们在三个模型家族上零样本评估了MOSAIC：Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen3-4B-Thinking、Phi-4和Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking，并跨越覆盖有害任务、提示注入、良性工具使用和跨域隐私泄露的分布外基准。

sentences.en: MOSAIC reduces harmful behavior by up to 50\%, increases harmful-task refusal by over 20\% on injection attacks, cuts privacy leakage, and preserves or improves benign task performance, demonstrating robust generalization across models, domains, and agentic settings.
sentences.zh: MOSAIC将有害行为最多降低50\%，将针对注入攻击的有害任务拒绝率提高20\%以上，并减少隐私泄露，同时保持或提升良性任务性能，展示了跨模型、跨领域以及智能体场景的稳健泛化。

title_en: Learning When to Attend: Conditional Memory Access for Long-Context LLMs
title_zh: 学习何时进行注意力：长上下文语言模型的条件式记忆访问

sentences.en: Language models struggle to generalize beyond pretraining context lengths, limiting long-horizon reasoning and retrieval.
sentences.zh: 语言模型难以泛化到超出预训练上下文长度的情况，这限制了长视界推理和检索。

sentences.en: Continued pretraining on long-context data can help but is expensive due to the quadratic scaling of Attention.
sentences.zh: 在长上下文数据上继续预训练可以有所帮助，但由于注意力（Attention）的二次方扩展而代价高昂。

sentences.en: We observe that most tokens do not require (Global) Attention over the entire sequence and can rely on local context.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，大多数token并不需要对整个序列进行（全局）注意力，可以依赖局部上下文。

sentences.en: Based on this, we propose L2A (Learning To Attend), a layer that enables conditional (token-wise) long-range memory access by deciding when to invoke global attention.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们提出了L2A（Learning To Attend），一个通过决定何时调用全局注意力来实现条件式（逐token）长距离记忆访问的层。

sentences.en: We evaluate L2A on Qwen 2.5 and Qwen 3 models, extending their effective context length from 32K to 128K tokens.
sentences.zh: 我们在Qwen 2.5和Qwen 3模型上评估了L2A，将其有效上下文长度从32K扩展到128K token。

sentences.en: L2A matches the performance of standard long-context training to within 3\% while skipping Global Attention for $\sim$80\% of tokens, outperforming prior baselines.
sentences.zh: L2A在匹配标准长上下文训练性能（差距在3\%以内）的同时，为大约$\sim$80\%的token跳过全局注意力，超越了先前的基线。

sentences.en: We also design custom Triton kernels to efficiently implement this token-wise conditional Attention on GPUs, achieving up to $\sim$2× improvements in training throughput and time-to-first-token over FlashAttention.
sentences.zh: 我们还设计了定制的Triton内核，以便在GPU上高效实现这种逐token的条件式注意力，与FlashAttention相比，训练吞吐量和首token时间（time-to-first-token）最高提升约$\sim$2倍。

sentences.en: Moreover, L2A enables post-training pruning of highly sparse Global Attention layers, reducing KV cache memory by up to 50\% with negligible performance loss.
sentences.zh: 此外，L2A支持对高度稀疏的全局注意力层进行训练后剪枝，将KV缓存内存最多降低50\%，且性能损失可忽略。

sentences.en: Our code is released under Apache 2.0 at https://github.com/awslabs/hybrid-model-factory/tree/main/examples/research/L2A.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码以Apache 2.0许可发布在https://github.com/awslabs/hybrid-model-factory/tree/main/examples/research/L2A。

title_en: Learning with Admissibility: Robust Fuzzy Hashing for Cross-Modal Retrieval with Noisy Labels
title_zh: 基于可接纳性的学习：面向噪声标签的鲁棒模糊哈希跨模态检索

sentences.en: Recently, cross-modal hashing (CMH) has garnered significant attention due to its low storage costs and high retrieval efficiency. most existing CMH methods implicitly assume the availability of high-quality annotations, which is often violated in real-world scenarios as label noise inevitably arises from human errors or non-expert annotations.
sentences.zh: 近年来，跨模态哈希（CMH）因其存储成本低、检索效率高而受到广泛关注。目前大多数CMH方法都隐式假设存在高质量标注，而在现实场景中这一假设常常不成立，因为标签噪声不可避免地来自人为错误或非专家标注。

sentences.en: To cope with noisy supervision, current noise-robust CMH methods mainly follow two paradigms, i.e., noise separation and label smoothing.
sentences.zh: 为了应对噪声监督，当前鲁棒噪声的CMH方法主要遵循两种范式，即噪声分离和标签平滑。

sentences.en: They often discard the predicted noisy instances or smooth discriminative signals to mitigate the impact of noisy labels.
sentences.zh: 它们常常丢弃被预测为含噪声的样本，或平滑判别信号，以减轻噪声标签的影响。

sentences.en: However, aggressive separation leads to reduced data utilization, while smoothing weakens the discriminative capability regarding the true distribution of clean instances.
sentences.zh: 然而，激进的分离会导致数据利用率降低，而平滑则会削弱针对干净样本真实分布的判别能力。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose a novel Robust Fuzzy Cross-modal Hashing framework (RFCMH) that introduces fuzzy set theory to endow the labels with admissibility, thereby obtaining reliable discriminative supervision from noisy labels.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些局限，我们提出了一个新的鲁棒模糊跨模态哈希框架（RFCMH），引入模糊集理论为标签赋予可接纳性，从而从噪声标签中获得可靠的判别监督。

sentences.en: Specifically, we first leverage possibility and necessity measures to model the noisy labels.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们首先利用可能性测度和必然性测度来对噪声标签建模。

sentences.en: Subsequently, we propose Fuzzy Admissibility Refinement (FAR) to dynamically calibrate supervision signals, thereby preventing the model from being misled by false positives.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们提出了模糊可接纳性精炼（FAR），动态校准监督信号，从而防止模型被假阳性误导。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we introduce Dual-Granularity Structural Alignment (DGSA) to enforce both cross-modal alignment and instance-level uniformity, ensuring stable and diverse representations.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了双粒度结构对齐（DGSA），同时强制跨模态对齐和实例级均匀性，确保表示稳定且多样。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that RFCMH achieves state-of-the-art retrieval performance.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，RFCMH取得了最先进的检索性能。

title_en: Learning, Solving and Optimizing PDEs with TensorGalerkin: an efficient high-performance Galerkin assembly algorithm
title_zh: 使用TensorGalerkin学习、求解和优化PDE：一种高效高性能的Galerkin装配算法

sentences.en: We present a unified algorithmic framework for the numerical solution, constrained optimization, and physics-informed learning of PDEs with a variational structure.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个统一算法框架，用于具有变分结构的偏微分方程（PDE）的数值求解、约束优化和物理信息学习。

sentences.en: Our framework is based on a Galerkin discretization of the underlying variational forms, and its high efficiency stems from a novel highly-optimized and GPU-compliant TensorGalerkin framework for linear system assembly (stiffness matrices and load vectors).
sentences.zh: 我们的框架基于底层变分形式的Galerkin离散化，其高效率源于一个新颖的、高度优化且适配GPU的TensorGalerkin线性系统装配（刚度矩阵和载荷向量）框架。

sentences.en: TensorGalerkin operates by tensorizing element-wise operations within a Python-level Map stage and then performs global reduction with a sparse matrix multiplication that performs message passing on the mesh-induced sparsity graph.
sentences.zh: TensorGalerkin通过在Python层的Map阶段对逐元素操作进行张量化来运行，然后通过稀疏矩阵乘法执行全局归约，该乘法在网格诱导的稀疏图上进行消息传递。

sentences.en: The Map and Reduce stages are co-designed inside PyTorch's autograd so that the assembly graph contains $O(1)$ nodes regardless of how the number of elements and local DoFs scale.
sentences.zh: Map和Reduce阶段在PyTorch的autograd内部协同设计，使得装配图无论元素数量和局部DoF如何扩展，都只包含$O(1)$个节点。

sentences.en: We validate this $O(1)$-graph property by deploying TensorGalerkin downstream as i) a highly-efficient numerical PDEs solver, ii) an end-to-end differentiable framework for PDE-constrained optimization, and iii) a physics-informed operator learning algorithm for PDEs.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将TensorGalerkin下游部署为：i) 高效的数值PDE求解器，ii) 用于PDE约束优化的端到端可微框架，以及iii) 用于PDE的物理信息算子学习算法，验证了这一$O(1)$图性质。

sentences.en: With multiple benchmarks, including 2D and 3D elliptic, parabolic, and hyperbolic PDEs on unstructured meshes, we demonstrate that the proposed framework provides significant computational efficiency and accuracy gains over a variety of baselines in all the targeted downstream applications.
sentences.zh: 通过多个基准（包括非结构网格上的2D和3D椭圆型、抛物型和双曲型PDE），我们证明了所提出的框架在所有目标下游应用中相对多种基线均带来了显著的计算效率和精度提升。

title_en: Learning-Augmented Online Covering Problems
title_zh: 学习增强的在线覆盖问题

sentences.en: We give a very general and simple framework to incorporate predictions on requests for online covering problems in a rigorous and black-box manner.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个非常通用且简单的框架，以严谨而黑盒的方式将关于请求的预测纳入在线覆盖问题。

sentences.en: Our framework turns any online algorithm with competitive ratio $\rho(k, \cdot)$ depending on $k$, the number of arriving requests, into an algorithm with competitive ratio of $\rho(\eta, \cdot)$, where $\eta$ is the prediction error.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架将任何竞争比为$\rho(k, \cdot)$（依赖于到达请求数量$k$）的在线算法，转化为竞争比为$\rho(\eta, \cdot)$的算法，其中$\eta$是预测误差。

sentences.en: With accurate enough prediction, the resulting competitive ratio breaks through the corresponding worst-case online lower bounds, and smoothly degrades as the prediction error grows.
sentences.zh: 当预测足够准确时，由此得到的竞争比突破了相应的最坏情况在线下界，并随预测误差增大而平滑退化。

sentences.en: This framework directly applies to a wide range of well-studied online covering problems such as facility location, Steiner problems, set cover, parking permit, etc., and yields improved and novel bounds.
sentences.zh: 该框架直接适用于大量研究充分的在线覆盖问题，例如设施选址、Steiner问题、集合覆盖、停车许可等，并带来了改进的和新颖的界。

title_en: Learning-Augmented Online Minimization with Dual Predictions
title_zh: 具有对偶预测的学习增强在线最小化

sentences.en: We present learning-augmented algorithms for two general classes of online minimization problems: metrical task systems and laminar set cover.
sentences.zh: 我们为两类一般的在线最小化问题提出了学习增强算法：度量任务系统和层状集合覆盖。

sentences.en: Both algorithms achieve improved theoretical guarantees using machine-learned predictions of an optimal solution to the dual linear program.
sentences.zh: 两种算法都利用对偶线性规划最优解的机器学习预测，实现了改进的理论保证。

sentences.en: Unlike optimal primal solutions, which can change drastically under tiny instance perturbations, these dual solutions are much more stable, which ensures the existence of good (and learnable) predictions for families of similar instances.
sentences.zh: 与最优原始解不同（它们会在微小的实例扰动下发生剧烈变化），这些对偶解要稳定得多，从而保证了在相似实例族上存在良好（且可学习）的预测。

sentences.en: While previous work has used dual predictions in offline settings and for online maximization problems, our algorithms are, to the best of our knowledge, the first demonstration that such dual predictions can be effective for online minimization.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前的工作已在离线设置和在线最大化问题中使用了对偶预测，但据我们所知，我们的算法是首次证明此类对偶预测对在线最小化也能有效。

sentences.en: Our theoretical results are complemented by experiments on the $k$-server problem and the parking permit problem.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论结果还辅以在$k$-服务器问题和停车许可问题上的实验。

title_en: Learning-augmented Rent-or-Buy with a Sample
title_zh: 带样本的学习增强租或买问题

sentences.en: In this paper, we study the rent-or-buy problem (also called the Bahncard problem) in the learning-augmented setting.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们研究学习增强设置下的租或买问题（也称为Bahncard问题）。

sentences.en: In this problem, a traveler must complete a sequence of trips that are revealed online over time, each of which has an associated cost with it.
sentences.zh: 在此问题中，旅行者必须按时间在线依次揭示来完成一系列行程，每一段行程都有一个与之相关的成本。

sentences.en: The traveler has the option of buying a discount card at a fixed cost that gives a discount on trip costs for a fixed time after buying the card.
sentences.zh: 旅行者可以选择以固定成本购买一张折扣卡，在购卡后的一段固定时间内，该卡可对行程成本给予折扣。

sentences.en: The goal is to minimize the overall cost of all the trips, including the money spent on buying discount cards.
sentences.zh: 目标是使所有行程的总成本最小化，包括购买折扣卡所花费的金钱。

sentences.en: For this problem, it is well-known that the best deterministic algorithm has a competitive ratio of 2.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，对于该问题，最好的确定性算法的竞争比为2。

sentences.en: In this paper, we ask whether we can do better if the traveler has a *sample* of trips available offline, e.g., obtained from an ML model based on historical data.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们要问：如果旅行者能离线获得一组旅程的 *样本*（例如由基于历史数据的ML模型获得），我们能否做得更好？

sentences.en: We show that even a sparse sample of the input can significantly improve the competitive ratio of the algorithm from 2 to 3/2, and further to close to 1 under some additional conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，即使是输入的稀疏样本也能将算法的竞争比从2显著改善到3/2，并且在某些附加条件下甚至可以进一步接近1。

sentences.en: We also verify our theoretical bounds via numerical simulations, which reveal that our proposed algorithm obtains nearly optimal solutions for a variety of natural input classes.
sentences.zh: 我们还通过数值模拟验证了我们的理论界，这些模拟显示，我们提出的算法对多种自然的输入类别都能获得近乎最优的解。

title_en: Learning-Augmented Scalable Linear Assignment Problem Optimization via Neural Dual Warm-Starts
title_zh: 通过神经对偶热启动的学习增强可扩展线性分配问题优化

sentences.en: The Linear Assignment Problem is a fundamental combinatorial optimization task where classical exact solvers ensure optimality but suffer from an $\mathcal{O}(N^{3})$ bottleneck, while recent neural approximations struggle with scalability and exactness.
sentences.zh: 线性分配问题是一类基本的组合优化任务，经典精确求解器能保证最优性，但受限于$\mathcal{O}(N^{3})$的瓶颈，而近来的神经近似方法则在可扩展性和精确性方面存在困难。

sentences.en: We propose a learning-augmented framework that accelerates exact solvers by predicting dual variables to warm-start the search, backed by a fallback mechanism to preserve worst-case guarantees.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个学习增强框架，通过预测对偶变量来热启动搜索以加速精确求解器，并辅以回退机制以保持最坏情况保证。

sentences.en: Central to our approach is RowDualNet, a lightweight, row-independent architecture that avoids the $\mathcal{O}(N^{2})$ memory bottleneck of graph models, enabling scalable neural warm-starting up to $N=16{,}384$.
sentences.zh: 我们方法的核心是RowDualNet，一种轻量级、行独立的架构，避免了图模型的$\mathcal{O}(N^{2})$内存瓶颈，使得在$N=16{,}384$时可进行可扩展的神经热启动。

sentences.en: Feasibility is guaranteed by construction via the Min-Trick mechanism, completely eliminating the need for costly iterative projections.
sentences.zh: 可行性通过Min-Trick机制在构造上得到保证，完全消除了对昂贵迭代投影的需求。

sentences.en: Empirically, our method drastically reduces the search effort of the Jonker-Volgenant (LAPJV) algorithm, yielding robust zero-shot generalization with strict optimality and end-to-end speedups of over 2x on complex synthetic data, 1.25x on real-world tracking, and 1.5x on transportation networks.
sentences.zh: 实验上，我们的方法显著减少了Jonker-Volgenant（LAPJV）算法的搜索工作量，实现了稳健的零样本泛化、严格最优性，并在复杂合成数据上取得超过2倍、在真实世界跟踪上取得1.25倍、在交通网络上取得1.5倍的端到端加速。

title_en: Learning-Guided Integration Contours Construction for Fast Large-Scale Generalized Eigensolvers
title_zh: 面向快速大规模广义特征值求解器的学习引导积分等高线构造

sentences.en: Solving large-scale Generalized Eigenvalue Problems (GEPs) is a fundamental yet computationally prohibitive task in science and engineering.
sentences.zh: 求解大规模广义特征值问题（GEP）是科学和工程领域中一项基础但计算开销巨大的任务。

sentences.en: As a promising direction, contour integral (CI) methods offer an efficient and parallelizable framework.
sentences.zh: 作为一个有前景的方向，等高线积分（CI）方法提供了一种高效且可并行的框架。

sentences.en: However, their performance is critically dependent on the selection of \textit{integration contours}---improper selection without reliable prior knowledge of eigenvalue distribution can incur significant computational overhead and compromise numerical accuracy.
sentences.zh: 然而，其性能在关键程度上依赖于\textit{integration contours}（积分等高线）的选择---如果没有关于特征值分布的可靠先验知识而选择不当，会产生显著的计算开销并损害数值精度。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose **Deepcontour**, a novel hybrid framework that integrates a deep learning-based spectral predictor with Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) for principled contour design.
sentences.zh: 为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 **Deepcontour**，一种新颖的混合框架，它将基于深度学习的谱预测器与核密度估计（KDE）相结合，用于合理的等高线设计。

sentences.en: Specifically, Deepcontour utilizes its specialized Eigen-Neural-Operator (ENO) to provide rapid spectral distribution priors, driving a KDE module to automatically construct the optimized integration contours, which guide the CI solver to efficiently find the desired eigenvalues.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，Deepcontour利用其专门的Eigen-Neural-Operator（ENO）快速提供谱分布先验，驱动KDE模块自动构造优化的积分等高线，从而引导CI求解器高效地找到所需的特征值。

sentences.en: Deepcontour achieves up to a 5.63x speedup across diverse scientific datasets while maintaining strict numerical rigor.
sentences.zh: 在多种科学数据集上，Deepcontour实现了最高5.63倍的加速，同时保持严格的数值严谨性。

sentences.en: By merging the predictive power of deep learning with the numerical rigor of classical solvers, this work establishes an efficient and robust paradigm for solving large-scale GEPs.
sentences.zh: 通过将深度学习的预测能力与经典求解器的数值严谨性相结合，这项工作为求解大规模GEP建立了一种高效且稳健的范式。

title_en: Learning-To-Measure: In-Context Active Feature Acquisition
title_zh: 学习测量：上下文内的主动特征获取

sentences.en: Active feature acquisition (AFA) is a sequential decision-making problem where the goal is to improve model performance for test instances by adaptively selecting which features to acquire.
sentences.zh: 主动特征获取（AFA）是一个序列决策问题，目标是通过自适应地选择要获取哪些特征来提高模型在测试实例上的性能。

sentences.en: In practice, AFA methods often learn from retrospective data with systematic missingness in the features and limited task-specific labels.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，AFA方法通常从具有系统性特征缺失和有限任务特定标签的回顾性数据中学习。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we introduce Learning-to-Measure (L2M), which consists of i) reliable uncertainty quantification over unseen tasks, and ii) an uncertainty-guided feature acquisition agent that maximizes conditional mutual information.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一局限，我们提出了学习测量（L2M），它包含：i) 对未见任务的可靠不确定性量化，以及 ii) 一个最大化条件互信息的不确定性引导特征获取智能体。

sentences.en: We demonstrate an autoregressive pre-training approach that underpins reliable uncertainty quantification and acquisition for tasks with arbitrary missingness.
sentences.zh: 我们展示了一种自回归预训练方法，它为具有任意缺失模式的任务提供了可靠不确定性量化与获取的基础。

sentences.en: L2M operates directly on datasets with retrospective missingness and performs the task in-context, eliminating per-task retraining.
sentences.zh: L2M直接在具有回顾性缺失的数据集上运行并以上下文内方式执行任务，免除了逐任务再训练。

sentences.en: Across synthetic and real-world tabular benchmarks, L2M matches or surpasses task-specific baselines, particularly under scarce labels and high missingness.
sentences.zh: 在合成和真实世界的表格基准上，L2M匹配或超越了任务特定基线，特别是在标签稀缺和缺失率高的情况下。

title_en: Learning-to-Optimize via Deep Unfolded Flows
title_zh: 通过深度展开流进行学习优化

sentences.en: We introduce *FlowOptimizer*, a deep unfolded, flow-based framework for learned iterative optimization.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 *FlowOptimizer*，一个用于学习式迭代优化的深度展开、基于流的框架。

sentences.en: Motivated by the expressiveness of flow models, we represent each optimization iteration via a velocity field that operates on a population of candidate solutions, i.e., a set of parallel iterates, conditioned on contextual information including their objective values and gradients, as well as population-level statistics.
sentences.zh: 受流模型表达力的启发，我们通过作用于候选解群体（即一组并行迭代）上的速度场来表示每次优化迭代，该速度场以包括目标值和梯度以及群体级统计量在内的上下文信息为条件。

sentences.en: The velocity field is initially trained in a simulation-free manner by matching displacements from source populations to improved target ones obtained through sampling the objective.
sentences.zh: 速度场首先以无模拟的方式训练，通过把从源群体出发的位移匹配到通过目标采样得到的、改进后的目标群体来实现。

sentences.en: Subsequently, we unfold this velocity field as the internal iteration of an optimization sequence, and fine-tune it in an end-to-end manner by directly optimizing objective values over a targeted class of problems.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们将该速度场展开为优化序列的内部迭代，并通过直接在某类目标问题上优化目标值来对其进行端到端微调。

sentences.en: Notably, FlowOptimizer is a self-supervised framework whose training relies solely on objective evaluations without requiring knowledge of solutions.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，FlowOptimizer是一个自监督框架，其训练仅依赖目标函数评估，无需知道解。

sentences.en: We evaluate our approach on a series of tasks from standard non-convex optimization benchmarks to real-world problems from supply chain, robotics and power grid applications.
sentences.zh: 我们在从标准非凸优化基准到供应链、机器人和电网应用等真实世界问题的一系列任务上评估了我们的方法。

sentences.en: FlowOptimizer consistently outperforms well-established sampling-based/gradient-based traditional optimization and learning-to-optimize methods, often by orders of magnitude in terms of solution quality.
sentences.zh: FlowOptimizer一贯优于成熟的基于采样/基于梯度的传统优化方法以及学习优化方法，在解质量上往往提升数个数量级。

sentences.en: We further highlight its ability to be trained on low-dimensional problems and successfully generalize to substantially higher-dimensional $(\times 10)$ ones.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步强调，它能够在低维问题上训练，并成功泛化到维度大幅更高（$\times 10$）的问题上。

title_en: Least-Loaded Expert Parallelism: Load Balancing An Imbalanced Mixture-of-Experts
title_zh: 最空闲专家并行：负载均衡一个不均衡的混合专家

sentences.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are typically pre-trained with explicit load-balancing constraints to ensure statistically balanced expert routing.
sentences.zh: 混合专家（MoE）模型通常以显式的负载均衡约束进行预训练，以确保统计上均衡的专家路由。

sentences.en: Despite this, we observe that even well-trained MoE models exhibit significantly imbalanced routing.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我们观察到即使是训练良好的MoE模型也表现出显著不均衡的路由。

sentences.en: This behavior is arguably natural—and even desirable—as imbalanced routing allows models to concentrate domain-specific knowledge within a subset of experts.
sentences.zh: 这种行为可以说是自然的，甚至是可取的，因为不均衡的路由使得模型能够将特定领域的知识集中在专家子集内。

sentences.en: Expert parallelism (EP) is designed to scale MoE models by distributing experts across multiple devices, but with a less-discussed assumption of balanced routing.
sentences.zh: 专家并行（EP）旨在通过将专家分布到多个设备上来扩展MoE模型，但它有一个较少被讨论的假设：路由是均衡的。

sentences.en: Under extreme imbalance, EP can funnel a disproportionate number of tokens to a small number of experts, leading to compute- and memory-bound failures on overloaded devices during post-training or inference, where explicit load balancing is often inapplicable.
sentences.zh: 在极端不均衡的情况下，EP会将不成比例的大量token导向少量专家，导致后训练或推理期间过载设备上出现计算和内存受限的失败，而此时显式负载均衡往往不适用。

sentences.en: We propose Least-Loaded Expert Parallelism (LLEP), a novel EP algorithm that dynamically reroutes excess tokens and associated expert parameters from overloaded devices to underutilized ones.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了最空闲专家并行（LLEP），一种新颖的EP算法，它动态地将多余的token及相关的专家参数从过载设备重新路由到未充分利用的设备。

sentences.en: This ensures that all devices complete their workloads within the minimum collective latency while respecting memory constraints.
sentences.zh: 这确保了所有设备在满足内存约束的同时，能在最小集体延迟内完成各自的工作负载。

sentences.en: Across different model scales, LLEP achieves up to 5x speedup and 4x reduction in peak memory usage compared to standard EP.
sentences.zh: 在不同的模型规模上，与标准EP相比，LLEP实现了最高5倍的加速和4倍的峰值内存降低。

sentences.en: This enables faster and higher-throughput post-training and inference, with ~1.9x faster for gpt-oss-120b.
sentences.zh: 这使得更快、更高吞吐的后训练和推理成为可能，对gpt-oss-120b而言速度快了约1.9倍。

sentences.en: We support our method with extensive theoretical analysis and comprehensive empirical evaluations, including ablation studies.
sentences.zh: 我们用广泛的理论分析和全面的经验评估（包括消融研究）来支持我们的方法。

sentences.en: These results illuminate key trade-offs and enable a principled framework for hardware-specific hyper-parameter tuning to achieve optimal performance.
sentences.zh: 这些结果揭示了关键的权衡，并为硬件特定的超参调节以实现最优性能提供了一个有原则的框架。

title_en: LEC: Linear Expectation Constraints for Selection-Conditioned Risk Control in Selective Prediction and Routing Systems
title_zh: LEC：用于选择性预测和路由系统中基于选择条件的风险控制的线性期望约束

sentences.en: Foundation models often generate unreliable answers, while heuristic uncertainty estimators fail to fully distinguish correct from incorrect outputs, causing users to accept erroneous answers without any statistical guarantee.
sentences.zh: 基础模型常常生成不可靠的答案，而启发式不确定性估计器又无法完全区分正确与错误的输出，导致用户在没有统计保证的情况下接受错误答案。

sentences.en: We address this problem through selection-conditioned risk control, aiming to ensure that an accepted prediction has an error probability no larger than a user-specified risk level.
sentences.zh: 我们通过基于选择条件的风险控制来解决这一问题，旨在确保被接受的预测其错误概率不超过用户指定的风险水平。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose LEC, a principled framework that reframes selective prediction as a decision problem governed by a *linear expectation constraint* over selection and error indicators.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了LEC，一个有原则的框架，它将选择性预测重新表述为受选择和错误指示符上的 *线性期望约束* 支配的决策问题。

sentences.en: This formulation directly controls the ratio between the expected number of accepted errors and the expected number of accepted predictions, which corresponds to the marginal error probability conditioned on selection.
sentences.zh: 这种表述直接控制被接受错误的期望数量与被接受预测的期望数量之比，这对应了以选择为条件的边际错误概率。

sentences.en: Under exchangeability, we derive a *finite-sample sufficient condition* that relies only on a held-out calibration set, enabling the computation of a risk-constrained, retention-maximizing threshold.
sentences.zh: 在可交换性假设下，我们推导出一个仅依赖留出校准集的 *有限样本充分条件*，从而能够计算受风险约束、最大化保留率的阈值。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we extend LEC to two-model routing systems: if the primary model's uncertainty exceeds its calibrated threshold, the input is delegated to a subsequent model, while maintaining system-level selection-conditioned error control.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们将LEC扩展到双模型路由系统：如果主模型的置信度超过其校准阈值，则输入被委派给后续模型，同时保持系统级的基于选择条件的错误控制。

sentences.en: Experiments on both closed-ended and open-ended question answering (QA) and vision question answering (VQA) demonstrate that LEC maintains the prescribed risk level in accepted predictions and substantially improves sample retention compared to baselines.
sentences.zh: 在封闭式问答（QA）和开放式问答以及视觉问答（VQA）上的实验表明，与基线相比，LEC在被接受的预测中保持规定的风险水平，并显著提高了样本保留率。

title_en: LECTOR: Joint Learning of Scientific Reasoning Graphs and Introduction Generation
title_zh: LECTOR：科学推理图与引言生成的联合学习

sentences.en: AI Scientists have shown promising progress across multiple stages of the research pipeline, among which automatic scientific paper writing remains a formidable challenge.
sentences.zh: AI科学家在研究流水线的多个阶段都展现了令人鼓舞的进展，其中自动科学论文写作仍然是一项艰巨的挑战。

sentences.en: The Introduction writing is especially challenging, which demands not only linguistic fluency, but logical soundness and verifiable faithfulness.
sentences.zh: 引言写作尤其具有挑战性，它不仅要求语言的流畅性，还要求逻辑上的严谨性和可验证的忠实性。

sentences.en: Most AI-assisted methods treat the task as text generation instead of reasoning and structuring, leading to severe drawbacks, *e.g.*, hallucinating citations.
sentences.zh: 大多数AI辅助方法将任务视为文本生成而非推理与结构化，这导致了严重的缺陷，*例如*，幻觉引文。

sentences.en: To address this, we first formulate the Content-Conditional Introduction Generation (CCIG) task, which requires grounding the Introduction in the paper's core evidence.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们首先形式化了内容条件引言生成（CCIG）任务，它要求将引言基于论文的核心证据。

sentences.en: We then propose **LECTOR**, a novel **Logic-Expression Co-Reinforcement Learning** framework that can strictly follow the scientist's logic, add high-quality citations and keep structured expressions.
sentences.zh: 然后我们提出了**LECTOR**，一种新颖的**逻辑表达式协同强化学习**框架，它能严格遵守科学家的逻辑、添加高质量引文并保持结构化表达。

sentences.en: LECTOR first constructs a logic-reasoning graph from the paper's main body to serve as a verifiable logical blueprint.
sentences.zh: LECTOR首先从论文主体构建一个逻辑推理图，作为可验证的逻辑蓝图。

sentences.en: Subsequently, it employs a Logic-Expression Co-Rewarding mechanism to jointly optimize for both the graph's structural fidelity and the final narrative's quality.
sentences.zh: 随后，它采用逻辑表达式协同奖励机制，联合优化图的保真度和最终叙述的质量。

sentences.en: We conduct a dataset from *Nature Communications* papers to assess our method.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了一个来自《Nature Communications》论文的数据集来评估我们的方法。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show consistent improvements in both logic fidelity and Introduction generation quality metrics, *e.g.*, Graph Quality **(+26.7%)**, Citation Quality **(+8.6%)**, and Paper Consistency **(+3.3%)**.
sentences.zh: 大量实验显示，在逻辑保真度和引言生成质量指标上都取得了一致的改进，*例如*，图质量**（+26.7%）**、引文质量**（+8.6%）**和论文一致性**（+3.3%）**。

sentences.en: Code and data are available at: https://github.com/Xiao-Youth/LECTOR
sentences.zh: 代码和数据可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/Xiao-Youth/LECTOR

title_en: Left–Right Symmetry Breaking in CLIP-Style Vision-Language Models Trained on Synthetic Spatial-Relation Data
title_zh: 在合成空间关系数据上训练的CLIP风格视觉语言模型中的左右对称破缺

sentences.en: Spatial understanding remains a key challenge in vision-language models.
sentences.zh: 空间理解仍然是视觉语言模型中的一个关键挑战。

sentences.en: Yet it is still unclear whether such understanding is truly acquired, and if so, through what mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种理解是否真正被获得，以及如果是的话，通过什么机制获得，目前仍不清楚。

sentences.en: We present a controllable 1D image–text testbed to probe how left–right relational understanding emerges in Transformer-based vision and text encoders trained with a CLIP-style contrastive objective.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个可控的一维图像-文本测试平台，用来探究以CLIP风格对比目标训练的基于Transformer的视觉和文本编码器中，左右关系理解是如何涌现的。

sentences.en: We train lightweight Transformer-based vision and text encoders end-to-end on paired descriptions of one- and two-object scenes and evaluate generalization to unseen object pairs while systematically varying label and layout diversity.
sentences.zh: 我们在单物体和双物体场景的配对描述上端到端地训练轻量级基于Transformer的视觉和文本编码器，并在系统地变化标签和布局多样性的同时，评估对未见物体对的泛化。

sentences.en: We find that contrastive training learns left–right relations and that label diversity, more than layout diversity, is the primary driver of generalization in this setting.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，对比训练能够学习左右关系，并且在该设置中，标签多样性（而非布局多样性）是泛化的主要驱动因素。

sentences.en: To gain the mechanistic understanding, we perform an attention decomposition and show that interactions between positional and token embeddings induce a horizontal attention gradient that breaks left–right symmetry in the encoders; ablating this contribution substantially reduces left–right discrimination.
sentences.zh: 为了获得机制性的理解，我们进行了注意力分解，并表明位置嵌入与token嵌入之间的交互会在编码器中诱导出水平的注意力梯度，从而破缺左右对称；消除这一贡献会显著降低左右辨别能力。

sentences.en: Our results provide a mechanistic insight of when and how CLIP-style models acquire relational competence.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果为CLIP风格模型何时以及如何获得关系能力提供了机制性的洞见。

title_en: LEGO-FL: Learning Heterogeneous Federated Models as a LEGO Assembly Games
title_zh: LEGO-FL：将异构联邦模型学习视为乐高拼装游戏

sentences.en: Just as LEGO pieces can be assembled into an unlimited variety of structures, heterogeneous federated learning (HFL) can be viewed as the assembly of diverse model components.
sentences.zh: 正如乐高积木可以拼装出无限多样的结构一样，异构联邦学习（HFL）也可以被视为多种模型组件的拼装。

sentences.en: Inspired by this analogy, we reformulate HFL as a LEGO-like assembly game.
sentences.zh: 受这一类比启发，我们将HFL重新表述为一种类似乐高的拼装游戏。

sentences.en: The central challenge in HFL lies in learning across heterogeneous model architectures, which hinders direct parameter sharing.
sentences.zh: HFL的核心挑战在于跨异构模型架构进行学习，这阻碍了直接的参数共享。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose to decompose models into a set of modular components—analogous to LEGO pieces and collaboratively learn these components across clients under predefined composition rules.
sentences.zh: 为了应对这一挑战，我们提出将模型分解为一组模块化组件，类比于乐高积木，并在预定义的组合规则下跨客户端协作学习这些组件。

sentences.en: Based on this perspective, we develop a novel federated learning framework, termed LEGO-FL, which enables flexible model construction while preserving collaborative learning.
sentences.zh: 基于这一视角，我们开发了一种新颖的联邦学习框架，称为LEGO-FL，它在保持协作学习的同时，支持灵活的模型构建。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of LEGO-FL under different heterogeneous settings and system scales.
sentences.zh: 大量实验验证了LEGO-FL在不同异构设置和系统规模下的有效性。

title_en: LEGO: An LLM-Enabled Hierarchical Optimizer for Tensor Computation Graphs with Structure-Aware Search and Compositional Synthesis
title_zh: LEGO：一种基于LLM的、带结构感知搜索与组合合成的张量计算图层次优化器

sentences.en: Automating end-to-end GPU kernel generation with Large Language Models (LLMs) faces a critical tension between global performance and exploration efficiency.
sentences.zh: 使用大语言模型（LLM）自动化端到端GPU内核生成面临着全局性能与探索效率之间的关键矛盾。

sentences.en: We present LEGO, a hierarchical framework that resolves this trade-off via a parallel multi-agent search over a recursive AND-OR FusionTree.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了LEGO，一个层次化框架，通过在递归的AND-OR FusionTree上进行并行多智能体搜索来解决这一权衡。

sentences.en: LEGO synergizes two complementary flows: Top-Down Construction decomposes complex graphs into valid, context-isolated sub-problems to guarantee correctness and enable parallel exploration, while Bottom-Up Mutation speculatively fuses verified sub-plans to recover global locality for peak performance.
sentences.zh: LEGO协同了两种互补流程：自上而下的构造将复杂图分解为有效、上下文隔离的子问题，以保证正确性并实现并行探索；而自下而上的变异则推测性地融合已验证的子计划，以恢复全局局部性从而实现峰值性能。

sentences.en: This bi-directional mechanism effectively prunes the search space to avoid repetitive unguided sampling, while naturally parallelizing exploration and enabling the discovery of sophisticated fusion strategies.
sentences.zh: 这种双向机制有效剪枝搜索空间以避免重复的无引导采样，同时自然地并行化探索，并使得发现复杂融合策略成为可能。

sentences.en: Evaluations demonstrate that LEGO achieves 2.18×–13.48× speedups over PyTorch Eager and, compared to monolithic baselines, reduces end-to-end exploration time by up to 2.47× and token consumption by up to 7×, across diverse end-to-end models.
sentences.zh: 评估表明，在各种端到端模型上，LEGO相比PyTorch Eager实现了2.18×–13.48×的加速，且与整体式基线相比，将端到端探索时间最多减少2.47×、token消耗最多减少7×。
