title_en: LEMUR: Learned Multi-Vector Retrieval
title_zh: LEMUR：学习式多向量检索

sentences.en: Multi-vector representations generated by late interaction models, such as ColBERT, enable superior retrieval quality compared to single-vector representations in information retrieval applications.
sentences.zh: 由晚期交互模型（如ColBERT）生成的多向量表示，在信息检索应用中比单向量表示能够实现更优的检索质量。

sentences.en: In multi-vector retrieval systems, both queries and documents are encoded using one embedding per token, and similarity between queries and documents is measured by the MaxSim similarity measure.
sentences.zh: 在多向量检索系统中，查询和文档都使用每个token一个嵌入的方式进行编码，查询与文档之间的相似度通过MaxSim相似度度量来测量。

sentences.en: However, the improved quality of multi-vector retrieval comes at the expense of significantly increased search latency.
sentences.zh: 然而，多向量检索质量的提升是以显著增加的搜索延迟为代价的。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce LEMUR, a simple yet efficient framework for multi-vector similarity search.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了LEMUR，一个简单而高效的多向量相似度搜索框架。

sentences.en: LEMUR consists of two consecutive problem reductions: First, we formulate multi-vector similarity search as a supervised learning problem that can be solved using a one-hidden-layer neural network.
sentences.zh: LEMUR由两个连续的归约组成：首先，我们将多向量相似度搜索表述为一个可以使用单隐层神经网络求解的有监督学习问题。

sentences.en: Second, we reduce inference under this model to single-vector similarity search in its latent space, enabling the use of existing single-vector search indexes to accelerate retrieval.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们将该模型下的推理归约为潜空间中的单向量相似度搜索，从而能够利用现有的单向量搜索索引来加速检索。

sentences.en: LEMUR is an order of magnitude faster than prior multi-vector similarity search methods.
sentences.zh: LEMUR比先前的多向量相似度搜索方法快一个数量级。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/ejaasaari/lemur
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在https://github.com/ejaasaari/lemur获取。

title_en: Length Generalization Bounds for Transformers
title_zh: Transformer的长度泛化界

sentences.en: Length generalization is a key property of a learning algorithm that enables it to make correct predictions on inputs of any length, given finite training data.
sentences.zh: 长度泛化是学习算法的一项关键性质，它使算法能在给定有限训练数据的情况下，对任意长度的输入做出正确预测。

sentences.en: To provide such a guarantee, one needs to be able to compute a length generalization bound, beyond which the model is guaranteed to generalize.
sentences.zh: 为了提供这样的保证，需要能够计算出一个长度泛化界，超过该界模型就保证能泛化。

sentences.en: This paper concerns the open problem of the computability of such generalization bounds for $\mathsf{C}$-$\mathsf{RASP}$, a class of languages which is closely linked to transformers.
sentences.zh: 本文关注与Transformer密切相关的语言类$\mathsf{C}$-$\mathsf{RASP}$的此类泛化界的可计算性这一开放问题。

sentences.en: A positive partial result was recently shown by Chen et al. for $\mathsf{C}$-$\mathsf{RASP}$ with only one layer and, under some restrictions, also with two layers.
sentences.zh: Chen等人最近对只有一层的$\mathsf{C}$-$\mathsf{RASP}$给出了一个正面的部分结果，并且在某些限制下对两层的也给出了结果。

sentences.en: We provide complete answers to the above open problem.
sentences.zh: 我们对上述开放问题给出了完整的答案。

sentences.en: Our main result is the non-existence of computable length generalization bounds for $\mathsf{C}$-$\mathsf{RASP}$ (already with two layers) and hence for transformers.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要结果是：$\mathsf{C}$-$\mathsf{RASP}$（即使是两层）并因此对Transformer而言，并不存在可计算的长度泛化界。

sentences.en: To complement this, we provide a computable bound for the positive fragment of $\mathsf{C}$-$\mathsf{RASP}$, which we show equivalent to fixed-precision transformers.
sentences.zh: 作为补充，我们为$\mathsf{C}$-$\mathsf{RASP}$的正面片段提供了一个可计算的界，并证明它与固定精度的Transformer等价。

sentences.en: For both positive $\mathsf{C}$-$\mathsf{RASP}$ and fixed-precision transformers, we show that the length complexity is exponential, and prove optimality of the bounds.
sentences.zh: 对于正面的$\mathsf{C}$-$\mathsf{RASP}$和固定精度的Transformer，我们都证明了长度复杂度是指数级的，并证明了所给界的优性。

title_en: LERD: Latent Event-Relational Dynamics for Neurodegenerative Classification
title_zh: LERD：用于神经退行性疾病分类的潜在事件-关系动力学

sentences.en: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) alters brain electrophysiology and disrupts multichannel EEG dynamics, making accurate and clinically useful EEG-based diagnosis increasingly important for screening and disease monitoring.
sentences.zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）会改变大脑电生理活动并扰乱多通道脑电（EEG）动力学，这使得准确且具有临床实用性的基于EEG的诊断对于筛查和疾病监测愈发重要。

sentences.en: However, many existing approaches rely on black-box classifiers and do not explicitly model the latent event timing and cross-channel coordination behind their decisions.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多现有方法依赖黑盒分类器，并未显式地建模其决策背后的潜在事件时间与跨通道协调。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose LERD, an end-to-end Bayesian latent event--relational dynamical system that infers latent neural events and their relational structure directly from multichannel EEG without event or interaction annotations.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些局限，我们提出了LERD，一个端到端的贝叶斯潜在事件-关系动力系统，它直接从不带事件或交互标注的多通道EEG中推断潜在神经事件及其关系结构。

sentences.en: LERD combines a continuous-time event inference module with a stochastic event-generation process to capture flexible temporal patterns, while incorporating an electrophysiology-inspired dynamical prior to guide learning in a principled way.
sentences.zh: LERD将连续时间事件推断模块与随机事件生成过程相结合，以捕捉灵活的时间模式，同时纳入受电生理启发的动力学先验，以有原则的方式引导学习。

sentences.en: We further provide theoretical analysis that yields a tractable IVP-based KL regularizer and stability guarantees for the inferred relational dynamics.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提供理论分析，给出一个可处理的基于初值问题（IVP）的KL正则化子以及推断出的关系动力学的稳定性保证。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on synthetic benchmarks and two real-world AD EEG cohorts demonstrate that LERD consistently outperforms strong baselines and yields physiology-aligned rate, timing, and graph summaries that help characterize group-level dynamical differences.
sentences.zh: 在合成基准和两个真实世界的AD脑电队列上的大量实验表明，LERD一贯优于强基线，并产生与生理相符的速率、时间和图摘要，有助于刻画群体层面的动力学差异。

title_en: Less Data, Faster Training: repeating smaller datasets speeds up learning via sampling biases
title_zh: 更少的数据、更快的训练：重复较小的数据集通过采样偏差加速学习

sentences.en: This work investigates the "small-vs-large gap", where repeating on _fewer samples_ can lead to _compute saving_ during training compared to using a larger dataset.
sentences.zh: 这项工作研究了“小-大差距”（small-vs-large gap）现象，即与使用更大数据集相比，在_更少的样本_上进行重复可以在训练期间带来_计算节省_。

sentences.en: This is observed across algorithmic tasks, architectures and optimizers and cannot be explained using prior theory.
sentences.zh: 这一现象在多种算法任务、架构和优化器上都能观察到，并且无法用先前的理论来解释。

sentences.en: We argue that the speedup comes from appropriate layer-wise growth enabled by _sampling biases_, which is more pronounced when the dataset size is smaller.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这种加速源于由_采样偏差_实现的适当的分层增长，当数据集规模较小时这一效果更为显著。

sentences.en: We provide both theoretical analysis and empirical evidence from various interventions.
sentences.zh: 我们从各种干预中提供了理论分析和经验证据。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that using a smaller dataset with more repetitions is not just a fallback strategy under data scarcity, but can be proactively leveraged as a favorable inductive biases for optimization, particularly in reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，使用较小数据集并进行更多重复不仅是在数据稀缺下的一种回退策略，而且可以被主动利用为一种有利的优化归纳偏差，尤其是在推理任务中。

title_en: Less Diverse, Less Safe: The Indirect But Pervasive Risk of Test-Time Scaling in Large Language Models
title_zh: 多样性越少，越不安全：大语言模型中测试时扩展的间接但普遍的风险

sentences.en: Test-Time Scaling (TTS) improves LLM reasoning by exploring multiple candidate responses and then operating over this set to find the best output.
sentences.zh: 测试时扩展（TTS）通过探索多个候选响应，然后在这个集合上进行操作以找到最佳输出来提升LLM的推理能力。

sentences.en: A tacit premise behind TTS is that sufficiently diverse candidate pools enhance reliability.
sentences.zh: TTS背后的一个默认前提是，足够多样的候选池能增强可靠性。

sentences.en: In this work, we show that this assumption in TTS introduces a previously unrecognized failure mode.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们表明TTS中的这一假设引入了一种此前未被认识的失败模式。

sentences.en: When candidate diversity is curtailed, even by a modest amount, TTS becomes much more likely to produce unsafe outputs.
sentences.zh: 当候选多样性受到削减时，哪怕是轻微的削减，TTS产生不安全输出的可能性也会大大增加。

sentences.en: We present a reference-guided diversity reduction protocol (RefDiv) that serves as a diagnostic attack to stress test TTS pipelines.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种参考引导的多样性缩减协议（RefDiv），作为压力测试TTS流水线的诊断性攻击。

sentences.en: Through extensive experiments across open-source models (e.g. Qwen3, Mistral, Llama3.1, Gemma3) and two widely used TTS strategies (Monte Carlo Tree Search and Best-of-N), constraining diversity consistently signifies the rate at which TTS produces unsafe results.
sentences.zh: 通过在开源模型（如Qwen3、Mistral、Llama3.1、Gemma3）和两种广泛使用的TTS策略（蒙特卡洛树搜索和Best-of-N）上进行的大量实验，约束多样性始终会影响TTS产生不安全结果的比率。

sentences.en: The effect is often stronger than that produced by prompts directly with high adversarial intent scores.
sentences.zh: 这种效应的强度往往超过由高对抗性意图得分的提示直接产生的效应。

sentences.en: This observed phenomenon also transfers across TTS strategies and to closed-source models (e.g. OpenAI o3-mini and Gemini-2.5-Pro), thus indicating that this is a general and extant property of TTS rather than a model-specific artifact.
sentences.zh: 这一观察到的现象还能跨TTS策略迁移，并适用于闭源模型（如OpenAI o3-mini和Gemini-2.5-Pro），从而表明这是TTS的一种普遍且现存的性质，而非特定模型特有的伪影。

sentences.en: Additionally, we find that numerous widely used safety guardrail classifiers (e.g. Llama-Guard), are unable to flag the adversarial input prompts generated by RefDiv, demonstrating that existing defenses offer limited protection against this diversity-driven failure mode.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们发现许多广泛使用的安全护栏分类器（如Llama-Guard）无法标记RefDiv生成的对抗性输入提示，这表明现有防御对这类由多样性驱动的失败模式提供的保护有限。

title_en: Less is Enough: Synthesizing Diverse Data in Feature Space of LLMs
title_zh: 少即是够：在LLM的特征空间中合成多样化数据

sentences.en: The diversity of post-training data is critical for effective downstream performance in large language models (LLMs).
sentences.zh: 后训练数据的多样性对于大语言模型（LLM）有效的下游性能至关重要。

sentences.en: Many existing approaches to constructing post-training data quantify diversity using text-based metrics that capture linguistic variation, but such metrics provide only weak signals for the task-relevant features that determine downstream performance.
sentences.zh: 许多现有构建后训练数据的方法使用基于文本的、捕捉语言变化的度量来量化多样性，但这类度量对于决定下游性能的任务相关特征只提供微弱的信号。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce ***Feature Activation Coverage* (FAC)** which measures data diversity in an interpretable feature space.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入了 ***特征激活覆盖率*（FAC）**，它在一个可解释的特征空间中度量数据多样性。

sentences.en: Building upon this metric, we further propose a diversity-driven data synthesis framework, named **FAC Synthesis**, that first uses a sparse autoencoder to identify missing features from a seed dataset, and then generates synthetic samples that explicitly reflect these features.
sentences.zh: 基于这一度量，我们进一步提出了一个由多样性驱动的数据合成框架，命名为 **FAC合成**，它首先使用稀疏自编码器从种子数据集中识别缺失的特征，然后生成明确反映这些特征的合成样本。

sentences.en: Experiments show that our approach consistently improves both data diversity and downstream performance on various tasks, including instruction following, toxicity detection, reward modeling, and behavior steering.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的方法在各种任务上（包括指令遵循、毒性检测、奖励建模和行为引导）一致地提高了数据多样性和下游性能。

sentences.en: Interestingly, we identify a shared, interpretable feature space across model families (i.e., LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen), enabling cross-model knowledge transfer.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，我们在多个模型家族（即LLaMA、Mistral和Qwen）之间识别出一个共享的、可解释的特征空间，从而实现跨模型的知识迁移。

sentences.en: Our work provides a solid and practical methodology for exploring data-centric optimization of LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作为探索LLM的数据中心化优化提供了一套扎实且实用的方法论。

title_en: Less Is More in Federated Continual Learning: RieSelect for Conflict-Aware Layer Selection in LLMs
title_zh: 联邦持续学习中的少即是多：RieSelect用于LLM中冲突感知的层选择

sentences.en: Federated continual learning (FCL) of large language models on edge devices is constrained by a communication--stability--plasticity trilemma.
sentences.zh: 边缘设备上大语言模型的联邦持续学习（FCL）受到通信-稳定性-可塑性三难困境的制约。

sentences.en: We reveal a less-is-more phenomenon: beyond a moderate layer upload ratio, stability loss offsets saturated plasticity gains, so overall continual performance no longer improves.
sentences.zh: 我们揭示了一个少即是多的现象：超过适度的层上传比例后，稳定性损失抵消了已经饱和的可塑性增益，因此整体持续学习性能不再提升。

sentences.en: Moreover, layer-wise conflict is heavy-tailed and concentrates in a few layers; denser uplink increasingly includes these layers, which disproportionately drives forgetting and motivates selective sparse communication.
sentences.zh: 此外，层级别的冲突呈重尾分布，集中在少数几层；更密集的上行链路越来越包含这些层，这不成比例地加剧遗忘，并促使我们采用选择性的稀疏通信。

sentences.en: Therefore, we introduce RieSelect, which treats stability as staying within a Fisher-metric safe basin around historical solutions.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们引入了RieSelect，它将稳定性视为停留在历史解周围的Fisher度量安全盆内。

sentences.en: Under this safe-basin constraint, we derive a layer-wise conflict score and a closed-form certified safe step size for finite local updates, and formulate selective uplink as a knapsack-based utility--risk selection, balancing plasticity gains against stability risks.
sentences.zh: 在此安全盆约束下，我们推导出层级别的冲突分数，以及针对有限局部更新的闭式认证安全步长，并将选择性上行链路表述为基于背包的效用-风险选择，从而平衡可塑性增益与稳定性风险。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that, under a per-round uplink budget, RieSelect achieves the best performance across task orders.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在每轮上行链路预算下，RieSelect在各种任务顺序上都取得了最佳性能。

sentences.en: Beyond this matched-budget setting, under standard communication protocols, RieSelect improves average accuracy by 18.99–28.14 points while reducing total uplink by 53–115$\times$.
sentences.zh: 除了这种预算匹配的设置外，在标准通信协议下，RieSelect将平均精度提升了18.99至28.14个百分点，同时将总上行链路减少了53至115$\times$。

title_en: Less Is More: Elevating RAG via Performance-Driven Context Compression
title_zh: 少即是多：通过性能驱动的上下文压缩提升RAG

sentences.en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving the timeliness of knowledge updates and the factual accuracy of large language models.
sentences.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为一种有前景的范式，用于提高大语言模型知识更新的时效性和事实准确性。

sentences.en: However, incorporating a large volume of retrieved documents significantly increases input length, leading to prohibitive computational costs.
sentences.zh: 然而，纳入大量检索到的文档会显著增加输入长度，导致计算成本高得难以承受。

sentences.en: Existing compression approaches often compromise task performance, primarily due to their reliance on predefined heuristics.
sentences.zh: 现有的压缩方法往往损害任务性能，这主要是因为它们依赖于预定义的启发式规则。

sentences.en: These heuristics fail to ensure that the compressed context is conducive to the generation tasks.
sentences.zh: 这些启发式规则无法确保压缩后的上下文有利于生成任务。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose CORE-RAG, a novel framework for context compression in RAG systems.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些局限，我们提出了CORE-RAG，一个用于RAG系统中上下文压缩的新颖框架。

sentences.en: CORE eliminates reliance on proxy heuristics through a performance-driven learning framework, which directy utilizes task performance as a feedback signal to iteratively refine the compressor policy.
sentences.zh: CORE通过一个性能驱动的学习框架消除了对代理启发式规则的依赖，该框架直接利用任务性能作为反馈信号来迭代优化压缩器策略。

sentences.en: Prior to this optimization process, we incorporate a knowledge distillation phase to initialize the compressor with a robust policy.
sentences.zh: 在此优化过程之前，我们引入一个知识蒸馏阶段，用一个稳健的策略来初始化压缩器。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our approach.
sentences.zh: 大量实验证明了我们方法的优越性。

sentences.en: At a high compression ratio of 3\%, CORE not only avoids performance degradation but also improves the average Exact Match (EM) score by 3.3 points compared to using full documents.
sentences.zh: 在高达3\%的压缩比下，CORE不仅避免了性能退化，而且与使用完整文档相比，将平均精确匹配（EM）分数提升了3.3分。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/ziqiangcui/CORE-RAG-ICML26.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在https://github.com/ziqiangcui/CORE-RAG-ICML26获取。

title_en: Less Is More: Fast and Accurate Reasoning with Cross-Head Unified Sparse Attention
title_zh: 少即是多：使用跨头统一稀疏注意力进行快速而准确的推理

sentences.en: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance through test-time scaling, but this incurs substantial computational overhead due to long decoding from short prompts.
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型通过测试时扩展获得了强大的性能，但由于从短提示生成长解码输出，这带来了巨大的计算开销。

sentences.en: While sparse attention can reduce latency and memory usage, existing methods often degrade reasoning accuracy because selection errors accumulate over long generation horizons, or require costly retraining.
sentences.zh: 虽然稀疏注意力可以降低延迟和内存占用，但现有方法常常损害推理准确性，因为选择误差在长生成区间上累积，或者需要昂贵的再训练。

sentences.en: We introduce LessIsMore, a training-free sparse attention mechanism for long-horizon reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了LessIsMore，一种用于长视界推理的免训练稀疏注意力机制。

sentences.en: Our key insight is that token importance in reasoning is global and stable: critical tokens are largely shared across attention heads and remain stable over decoding steps.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是，推理中的token重要性是全局且稳定的：关键token在注意力头之间大体是共享的，并且在解码步骤上保持稳定。

sentences.en: Guided by this structure, LessIsMore enforces cross-head unified token selection and preserves recent context via a stable recency window, yielding a globally consistent token set that can be reused across layers.
sentences.zh: 在这一结构引导下，LessIsMore强制执行跨头统一的token选择，并通过稳定的近期窗口保留近期上下文，从而产生一个可以在各层之间复用的全局一致的token集合。

sentences.en: Across multiple model families and challenging reasoning benchmarks, LessIsMore matches or improves accuracy while attending to substantially fewer tokens.
sentences.zh: 在多个模型家族和具有挑战性的推理基准上，LessIsMore在关注显著更少token的同时，匹配或提升了准确性。

sentences.en: With kernel-level optimizations, LessIsMore achieves up to $1.6\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup and up to $1.72\times$ faster sparse attention computation, with additional long-context results demonstrating the generality of our approach.
sentences.zh: 借助内核级优化，LessIsMore实现了最高$1.6\times$的端到端解码加速和最高$1.72\times$的稀疏注意力计算加速，额外的长上下文结果进一步证明了我们方法的通用性。

title_en: Less is More: Geometric Unlearning for LLMs with Minimal Data Disclosure
title_zh: 少即是多：以最少数据披露实现LLM的几何遗忘

sentences.en: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world systems, they must support post-hoc removal of specific content to meet privacy and governance requirements.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署在真实系统中，它们必须支持事后移除特定内容，以满足隐私和治理要求。

sentences.en: This motivates selective unlearning, which suppresses information about a particular entity or topic while preserving the LLM's general utility.
sentences.zh: 这推动了选择性遗忘的发展，即在保持LLM一般实用性的同时，抑制关于特定实体或主题的信息。

sentences.en: However, most existing LLM unlearning methods require access to the original training corpus and rely on output-level refusal tuning or broad gradient updates, creating a tension among unlearning strength, non-target preservation, and data availability.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有的LLM遗忘方法需要访问原始训练语料，并依赖于输出级拒绝微调或宽泛的梯度更新，这在遗忘强度、非目标保持和数据可用性之间造成了矛盾。

sentences.en: We propose Geometric Unlearning (GU), an approach that operates directly on the model's prompt-conditioned hidden states without access to the original training corpus.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了几何遗忘（GU），一种直接在模型的提示条件隐藏状态上运作、无需访问原始训练语料的方法。

sentences.en: Specifically, GU distills a compact, low-rank safe-behavior subspace from a small set of safe reference prompts and uses lightweight anchor-in-context synthetic prompts to trigger localized, projection-based alignment of hidden representations to this safe subspace.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，GU从一个小的安全参考提示集合中蒸馏出一个紧凑的低秩安全行为子空间，并使用轻量级的锚点上下文化合成提示来触发隐藏表示向该安全子空间的局部、基于投影的对齐。

sentences.en: A teacher-distillation regularizer on synthetic non-target anchors further reduces collateral drift.
sentences.zh: 在合成非目标锚点上的教师蒸馏正则化子进一步减少了附带漂移。

sentences.en: Across privacy-oriented unlearning benchmarks (ToFU and UnlearnPII), GU achieves strong target suppression with minimal impact on non-target performance, demonstrating that effective unlearning can be achieved with minimal synthetic data.
sentences.zh: 在面向隐私的遗忘基准（ToFU和UnlearnPII）上，GU实现了对目标内容的强烈抑制，而对非目标性能的影响极小，从而证明只需极少的合成数据就能实现有效的遗忘。

title_en: Less Precise Can Be More Reliable: A Systematic Evaluation of Quantization’s Impact on VLMs Beyond Accuracy
title_zh: 精度更低反而更可靠：对量化超出准确度之外对VLM影响的系统评估

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP have revolutionized zero-shot classification and safety-critical tasks, including Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection.
sentences.zh: 诸如CLIP之类的视觉语言模型（VLM）已经革新了零样本分类和涉及安全关键的任务，包括分布外（OOD）检测。

sentences.en: However, their high computational cost hinders efficient real-world deployment.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们高昂的计算成本阻碍了高效的现实部署。

sentences.en: While quantization is a standard solution for efficiency, its broader impact on reliability metrics beyond simple Top-1 accuracy remains critically under-explored.
sentences.zh: 虽然量化是提高效率的标准解决方案，但其对超出简单Top-1准确度之外可靠性指标的更广泛影响，仍然研究严重不足。

sentences.en: In this study, we conduct a large-scale evaluation of VLM quantization across a comprehensive experimental suite of over 700k evaluation runs with varying configurations.
sentences.zh: 在这项研究中，我们在一个包含超过70万次不同配置评估运行的全面实验套件上，对VLM量化进行了大规模评估。

sentences.en: We find that, contrary to the assumption that quantization's noise degrades performance, it can simultaneously improve accuracy, calibration, OOD detection, and robustness to noise, though not to covariate shift or spurious correlations.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，与量化噪声会损害性能的假设相反，量化可以同时提高准确度、校准、OOD检测以及对噪声的鲁棒性，尽管对协变量偏移或虚假相关没有帮助。

sentences.en: We leverage these counterintuitive findings to characterize the mechanics of quantization beyond simple regularization: we show that quantization dampens high-rank spectral components, compelling the model to rely more heavily on robust, low-rank features.
sentences.zh: 我们利用这些反直觉的发现来刻画量化超越简单正则化的机制：我们表明，量化会抑制高秩的谱分量，迫使模型更多地依赖稳健的低秩特征。

sentences.en: Ultimately, this spectral filtering effect drives the observed improvements in generalization and noise tolerance, establishing a pathway to deploy faster, more reliable VLMs by utilizing quantization beyond its conventional role.
sentences.zh: 最终，这种谱滤波效应驱动了观察到的泛化和噪声容忍度的提升，从而为利用量化超越其传统角色的方式部署更快、更可靠的VLM开辟了一条路径。

title_en: Less Token, More Signal: MoE Expert Pruning via Critical Token Selection
title_zh: 更少的token，更多的信号：通过关键token选择进行MoE专家剪枝

sentences.en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures provide strong scalability for large language models, but their large expert parameter footprint poses challenges for efficient deployment.
sentences.zh: 混合专家（MoE）架构为大语言模型提供了强大的可扩展性，但其庞大的专家参数占用给高效部署带来了挑战。

sentences.en: Expert pruning is widely used to reduce model size and inference cost; however, existing approaches are token-agnostic, treating all tokens equally when estimating expert importance.
sentences.zh: 专家剪枝被广泛用于减少模型大小和推理成本；然而，现有方法都是token无关的，在估计专家重要性时将所有的token一视同仁。

sentences.en: This uniform treatment dilutes the contributions of informative tokens and leads to suboptimal pruning decisions.
sentences.zh: 这种统一的处理方式稀释了信息性token的贡献，导致次优的剪枝决策。

sentences.en: To address this fundamental limitation, we propose **Step** (**S**elective **T**oken-guided **E**xpert **P**runing), a token-aware framework that rethinks expert pruning from the perspective of selective token guidance.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一根本性局限，我们提出了 **Step**（**S**elective **T**oken-guided **E**xpert **P**runing，选择性token引导的专家剪枝），一个从选择性token引导角度重新思考专家剪枝的token感知框架。

sentences.en: By incorporating loss-aware expert evaluation and a lightweight knowledge-preserving mechanism, **Step** reduces information loss while removing redundant experts.
sentences.zh: 通过纳入损失感知的专家评估和轻量级的知识保持机制，**Step**在移除冗余专家的同时减少了信息损失。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across different MoE architectures and model scales demonstrate the effectiveness of **Step**.
sentences.zh: 跨越不同MoE架构和模型规模的大量实验证明了 **Step** 的有效性。

sentences.en: On the 30B Qwen3 MoE model with 50\% expert sparsity, **Step** achieves nearly a 50\% reduction in memory usage with minimal performance degradation, delivers a 1.5$\times$ throughput improvement, and completes the entire pruning process within 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 在具有50\%专家稀疏度的30B Qwen3 MoE模型上，**Step**在内存占用上实现了近50\%的降低而性能损失极小，带来了1.5$\times$的吞吐量提升，并在10分钟内完成了整个剪枝过程。

title_en: Let EEG Models Learn EEG
title_zh: 让EEG模型学习EEG

sentences.en: High-fidelity EEG generation is critical for alleviating data scarcity and addressing privacy constraints in large-scale neural modeling.
sentences.zh: 高保真的EEG生成对于缓解数据稀缺和解决大规模神经建模中的隐私约束至关重要。

sentences.en: Despite recent progress, most existing approaches formulate EEG generation via discrete denoising objectives, which inadequately reflect the inherently continuous temporal dynamics and spectral structure of neural activity.
sentences.zh: 尽管近期已有进展，但大多数现有方法通过离散去噪目标来构建EEG生成，这不足以反映神经活动固有的连续时间动力学和频谱结构。

sentences.en: As a result, these methods often struggle to preserve long-range temporal dependencies and exhibit mismatches in the spectral and temporal structure of the generated signals.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些方法常常难以保持长距离的时间依赖，并在生成信号的频谱和时间结构上表现出不匹配。

sentences.en: In this work, we argue that effective EEG generation requires models that operate directly on the continuous evolution of neural signals.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们认为有效的EEG生成需要直接在神经信号连续演化上运作的模型。

sentences.en: We introduce Just EEG Transformer (JET), a generative framework based on conditional flow matching that models EEG as raw sequences evolving along continuous trajectories.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了Just EEG Transformer（JET），一个基于条件流匹配的生成框架，将EEG建模为沿连续轨迹演化的原始序列。

sentences.en: By learning a smooth vector field that transports noise to the EEG data distribution, JET captures temporal continuity and transient dynamics without relying on discretized denoising schemes or domain-specific representations.
sentences.zh: 通过学习一个将噪声输运到EEG数据分布的平滑向量场，JET在无需依赖离散化去噪方案或领域特定表示的情况下，捕捉时间连续性和瞬态动力学。

sentences.en: To ensure that the learned dynamics remain consistent with key properties of EEG signals, we introduce principled constraints that preserve spectral structure, temporal stationarity, and signal-level statistics.
sentences.zh: 为了确保学习到的动力学与EEG信号的关键性质保持一致，我们引入了保留频谱结构、时间平稳性和信号级统计量的原则性约束。

sentences.en: Across three large-scale benchmarks, JET consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, reducing TS-FID by over 40\% compared to strong baselines.
sentences.zh: 在三个大规模基准上，JET持续取得最先进的性能，与强基线相比将TS-FID降低了超过40\%。

sentences.en: Extensive analyses show that JET captures key structural properties of neural dynamics, providing a scalable and principled approach to EEG generation.
sentences.zh: 广泛的分析表明，JET捕捉了神经动力学的关键结构性质，为EEG生成提供了一种可扩展且有原则的方法。

title_en: Let Language Constrain Geometry: Vision–Language Models as Semantic and Spatial Critics for 3D Generation
title_zh: 让语言约束几何：视觉语言模型作为3D生成的语义与空间批判者

sentences.en: Text-to-3D generation has advanced rapidly, yet state-of-the-art models, encompassing both optimization-based and feed-forward architectures, still face two fundamental limitations.
sentences.zh: 文本到3D生成已快速发展，然而最先进的模型（包括基于优化的架构和前馈架构）仍面临两个根本性局限。

sentences.en: First, they struggle with coarse semantic alignment, often failing to capture fine-grained prompt details.
sentences.zh: 首先，它们在粗粒度语义对齐上存在困难，常常无法捕捉细粒度的提示细节。

sentences.en: Second, they lack robust 3D spatial understanding, leading to geometric inconsistencies and catastrophic failures in part assembly and spatial relationships.
sentences.zh: 其次，它们缺乏稳健的3D空间理解，导致几何不一致以及部件装配和空间关系上的灾难性失败。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose VLM3D, a general framework that repurposes large vision-language models (VLMs) as powerful, differentiable {semantic and spatial critics}.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了VLM3D，一个通用框架，将大型视觉语言模型（VLM)重新用作强大的、可微分的 {语义与空间批判者}。

sentences.en: Our core contribution is a {dual-query critic signal} derived from the VLM's "Yes/No" log-odds, which assesses both semantic fidelity and geometric coherence.
sentences.zh: 我们的核心贡献是源于VLM“是/否”对数几率（log-odds）的 {双查询批判信号}，它同时评估语义保真度和几何一致性。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the generality of this guidance signal across two distinct paradigms: (1) As a reward objective for optimization-based pipelines, VLM3D significantly outperforms existing methods on standard benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们展示了这一引导信号在两种不同范式上的通用性：(1) 作为基于优化流水线的奖励目标，VLM3D在标准基准上显著优于现有方法。

sentences.en: (2) As a test-time guidance module for feed-forward pipelines, it actively steers the iterative sampling process of SOTA native 3D models to correct severe spatial errors.
sentences.zh: (2) 作为前馈流水线的测试时引导模块，它主动引导SOTA原生3D模型的迭代采样过程，以纠正严重的空间错误。

sentences.en: VLM3D establishes a principled and generalizable path to inject the VLM's rich, language-grounded understanding of both semantics and space into diverse 3D generative pipelines.
sentences.zh: VLM3D建立了一条有原则且可泛化的途径，将VLM丰富且以语言为基础的语义与空间理解注入到多种3D生成流水线中。

title_en: Let the Prototype Guide You: Robust Aggregation of Sparse Multi-Class Annotations via Annotator Prototype Learning
title_zh: 让原型引导你：通过标注者原型学习稳健地聚合稀疏多类标注

sentences.en: Truth inference is a critical technique for aggregating noisy and biased multi-class classification annotations.
sentences.zh: 真值推断是聚合带有噪声和偏差的多类分类标注的一项关键技术。

sentences.en: State-of-the-art approaches model each annotator using an individual confusion matrix.
sentences.zh: 最先进的方法使用个体混淆矩阵对每个标注者建模。

sentences.en: While well-grounded, they suffer from two fundamental bottlenecks: 1) confusion matrices are underfit when annotators label only a small subset of tasks or when classes are imbalanced, and 2) a single confusion matrix per annotator is inadequate for capturing complex annotator behaviors, leading to class-level collapse when tasks are extremely difficult.
sentences.zh: 尽管基础扎实，但它们存在两个根本性瓶颈：1) 当标注者只标注很小一部分任务或类别不平衡时，混淆矩阵会欠拟合；2) 每个标注者单个混淆矩阵不足以捕捉复杂的标注者行为，在任务极其困难时会导致类别级别的坍缩。

sentences.en: Simultaneously addressing these challenges is non-trivial, as it demands both robustness to data sparsity and sufficient expressiveness for complex annotator patterns.
sentences.zh: 同时解决这些挑战并非易事，因为它既要求对数据稀疏性的鲁棒性，又要求对复杂标注者模式有足够的表达能力。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose \textbf{CPBCC} (\textbf{C}lass-specific \textbf{P}rototype-driven \textbf{B}ayesian \textbf{C}lassifier \textbf{C}ombination), which creatively models annotators through a dual-pathway architecture: (i) learning class-specific prototype annotation patterns across all annotators, and (ii) learning annotator-specific weights over prototypes.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 \textbf{CPBCC}（\textbf{C}lass-specific \textbf{P}rototype-driven \textbf{B}ayesian \textbf{C}lassifier \textbf{C}ombination，类特定原型驱动的贝叶斯分类器组合），它通过双路径架构创造性地对标注者建模：(i) 学习跨所有标注者的类特定原型标注模式，以及 (ii) 学习原型上的标注者特定权重。

sentences.en: This framework addresses the bottlenecks and achieves a robust yet rich annotator characterization.
sentences.zh: 这一框架解决了上述瓶颈，实现了稳健而丰富的标注者刻画。

sentences.en: Experiments across 10 real-world datasets spanning five domains demonstrate that CPBCC yields a 26\% accuracy improvement in the best case, and boosts average accuracy from 68.73\% to 74.11\%.
sentences.zh: 跨越五个领域的10个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，CPBCC在最佳情况下带来了26\%的准确度提升，并将平均准确度从68.73\%提高到74.11\%。

sentences.en: Our source code is available at \url{https://github.com/JuJuCHEN-HHU/CPBCC_PTBCC}.
sentences.zh: 我们的源代码可在\url{https://github.com/JuJuCHEN-HHU/CPBCC_PTBCC}获取。

title_en: Letting Trajectories Spread: Quality-Preserving Control for Diverse Flow Matching
title_zh: 让轨迹展开：面向多样化流匹配的质量保持控制

sentences.en: Flow-based text-to-image models follow deterministic trajectories, making it costly to explore diverse modes under limited sampling budgets.
sentences.zh: 基于流的文本到图像模型遵循确定性轨迹，这使得在有限采样预算下探索多样的模式代价高昂。

sentences.en: Existing approaches to improving diversity often rely on retraining or degrade image fidelity.
sentences.zh: 现有提高多样性的方法往往依赖再训练，或者损害图像保真度。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we present a training-free, inference-time control mechanism that makes the flow itself diversity-aware.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一局限，我们提出了一种免训练、推理时的控制机制，使流本身具有多样性感知能力。

sentences.en: Our core insight is to encourage diversity through guidance that is geometrically decoupled from the model’s quality-seeking direction.
sentences.zh: 我们的核心洞见是，通过几何上与模型追求质量的趋势解耦的引导来鼓励多样性。

sentences.en: Our method simultaneously encourages lateral spread among trajectories via a feature-space objective and reintroduces uncertainty through a time-scheduled stochastic perturbation.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法同时通过特征空间目标鼓励轨迹之间的横向展开，并通过按时间调度的随机扰动重新引入不确定性。

sentences.en: Crucially, this perturbation is projected to be orthogonal to the generation flow, a geometric constraint that allows it to boost variation without degrading image details or prompt fidelity.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，这种扰动被投影为与生成流正交，这一几何约束使其能在不降低图像细节或提示保真度的情况下提升变化性。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we show that this design monotonically increases a volume surrogate while approximately preserving the marginal distribution, providing a principled explanation for the robustness of generation quality.
sentences.zh: 理论上，我们表明这种设计单调地增加一个体积代理指标，同时近似保持边缘分布，为生成质量的鲁棒性提供了有原则的解释。

sentences.en: Empirically, across multiple text-to-image settings under fixed sampling budgets, our method consistently improves diversity metrics such as the Vendi Score and Brisque over strong baselines, while upholding image quality and alignment.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，在固定采样预算下的多个文本到图像设置中，我们的方法在Vendi分数和Brisque等多样性指标上一致优于强基线，同时保持了图像质量和对齐。

title_en: Leveraging Evidence Priors for Robust Prompt Learning under Noisy Supervision in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 利用证据先验在视觉语言模型噪声监督下进行稳健的提示学习

sentences.en: Prompt learning for vision-language models (VLMs) often suffers from performance degradation when adapting to downstream tasks with noisy labels.
sentences.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的提示学习在适配到带有噪声标签的下游任务时，常常遭遇性能下降。

sentences.en: Existing methods that rely on filtering or reconstructing supervision can propagate errors, leading to sharp performance drops.
sentences.zh: 依赖过滤或重构监督的现有方法会传播误差，导致性能急剧下降。

sentences.en: We observe that pre-trained embeddings are resilient to label noise, offering stable references despite limited adaptation.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，预训练的嵌入对标签噪声具有鲁棒性，即使在有限适配的情况下也能提供稳定的参考。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we propose Evidence-Prompt, a framework built on the evidence prior that enhances prompt learning by integrating stable pre-trained knowledge.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出了Evidence-Prompt，一个建立在证据先验之上的框架，通过整合稳定的预训练知识来增强提示学习。

sentences.en: We treat prompt learning as a Bayesian reasoning task, where credibility is derived from both supervision-agnostic and supervision-conditioned evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们将提示学习视为一个贝叶斯推理任务，其可信度来源于与监督无关的证据和以监督为条件的证据。

sentences.en: This framework effectively combines these sources to infer robust training targets under noisy conditions, enabling stable learning even with high noise levels.
sentences.zh: 该框架有效地结合这些来源，在噪声条件下推断稳健的训练目标，即使在噪声水平较高时也能实现稳定学习。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks with both synthetic and real-world noisy labels demonstrate that our method flattens the accuracy–noise curve and consistently outperforms SOTA methods, with notable gains on OxfordPets dataset at a 75\% noise rate (+36.6\% under Asym and +14.4\% under Sym).
sentences.zh: 在八个带有合成和真实世界噪声标签的基准上的大量实验表明，我们的方法使准确度-噪声曲线趋于平坦，并一贯优于SOTA方法，在75\%噪声率下的OxfordPets数据集上取得显著提升（Asym噪声下+36.6\%，Sym噪声下+14.4\%）。

sentences.en: Additionally, transferability experiments reveal that incorporating our evidence prior into other SOTA methods results in accuracy improvements ranging from 2.6\% to 15.66\%.
sentences.zh: 此外，可迁移性实验表明，将我们的证据先验纳入其他SOTA方法会带来2.6\%到15.66\%的准确度提升。

title_en: Leveraging Gauge Freedom for Learning Non-Gradient Population Dynamics of Stochastic Systems
title_zh: 利用规范自由度学习随机系统的非梯度群体动力学

sentences.en: In existing works on population dynamics inference, there is a focus on flows arising from vector fields that are the gradients of scalar potentials.
sentences.zh: 在现有的群体动力学推断工作中，重点放在由标量势的梯度向量场所产生的流上。

sentences.en: Among all admissible flows that are compatible with the population dynamic, gradient flows are optimal in a specific sense: they minimize kinetic energy.
sentences.zh: 在所有与群体动力学兼容的容许流中，梯度流在特定意义下是最优的：它们使动能最小化。

sentences.en: The selection of fields based on different criteria corresponds to a gauge freedom when determining population dynamics, which we leverage in this work.
sentences.zh: 基于不同标准选择场，对应着确定群体动力学时的规范自由度，我们在本工作中利用了这一点。

sentences.en: We propose Non-Gradient Inference Flows (NGIF), an algorithm to infer non-gradient population dynamics using a weak formulation of the continuity equation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了非梯度推断流（NGIF），一种使用连续性方程弱形式来推断非梯度群体动力学的算法。

sentences.en: This allows us to parameterize with general vector fields as well as choose other selection criteria beyond minimal energy.
sentences.zh: 这使得我们能够用一般向量场进行参数化，并选择最小能量之外的其他选择标准。

sentences.en: We demonstrate on a variety of low- and high-dimensional physics problems that this more general approach improves distributional accuracy over gradient-restricted baselines and better captures non-potential transport.
sentences.zh: 我们在各种低维和高维物理问题上证明，这种更一般的方法相对于受梯度限制的基线提高了分布精度，并能更好地捕捉非势输运。

title_en: Leveraging Lineage Barcodes as Natural Augmentations for Contrastive Learning of Cell Fate in scRNA-seq Data
title_zh: 利用谱系条形码作为自然增强，用于scRNA-seq数据中细胞命运的对比学习

sentences.en: Deciphering how cells commit to future fates is essential for developing precision therapeutics that can reprogram stem cells or modulate immune functions.
sentences.zh: 破译细胞如何确定未来的命运，对于开发能够重编程干细胞或调节免疫功能的高精度疗法至关重要。

sentences.en: However, isolating these fate-determining signals in single-cell lineage tracing (scLT) remains challenging because differentiation programs are often confounded by unrelated processes like the cell cycle.
sentences.zh: 然而，在单细胞谱系追踪（scLT）中分离这些决定命运的信号仍然具有挑战性，因为分化程序常常被细胞周期等无关过程混淆。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce Lineage-aware Contrastive Learning (LCL), a framework that treats inheritable lineage barcodes as a "natural" data augmentation to isolate subtle, lineage-specific signals.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们引入了谱系感知的对比学习（LCL），一个将可遗传的谱系条形码视为“自然”数据增强，以分离细微的、谱系特异的信号的框架。

sentences.en: LCL utilizes a semi-supervised architecture to align unlabeled cells, facilitating the transfer of lineage structures to clinical datasets where explicit barcoding is unavailable.
sentences.zh: LCL利用半监督架构对齐未标记细胞，促进将谱系结构迁移到无法进行显式条形码标记的临床数据集。

sentences.en: We demonstrate LCL’s utility by predicting future cell-type compositions from early-time points, effectively modeling longitudinal fate commitment from cross-sectional data.
sentences.zh: 我们通过从早期时间点预测未来的细胞类型组成来展示LCL的实用性，有效地从横断面数据建模纵向的命运确定。

sentences.en: Benchmarking on hematopoietic and fibroblast systems shows that LCL significantly outperforms standard models like scVI, establishing contrastive learning as a scalable paradigm for understanding and potentially manipulating cellular differentiation.
sentences.zh: 在造血和成纤维细胞系统上的基准测试表明，LCL显著优于scVI等标准模型，将对比学习确立为理解和潜在操纵细胞分化的可扩展范式。

title_en: Leveraging Machine Unlearning for Cost-Efficient Preference Alignment
title_zh: 利用机器遗忘实现成本高效的偏好对齐

sentences.en: Despite advances in Preference Alignment (PA) for Large Language Models (LLMs), mainstream methods like reinforcement learning with human feedback face notable challenges.
sentences.zh: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）的偏好对齐（PA）已经取得了进展，但诸如基于人类反馈的强化学习等主流方法仍面临显著的挑战。

sentences.en: These approaches require high-quality datasets of positive preference examples, which are costly to obtain and computationally intensive.
sentences.zh: 这些方法需要高质量的正偏好示例数据集，而这些数据获取成本高昂且计算密集。

sentences.en: The LLM unlearning technique presents a promising alternative by directly removing the influence of negative examples.
sentences.zh: LLM遗忘技术通过直接消除负示例的影响，提供了一种有前景的替代方案。

sentences.en: However, current research has primarily focused on empirical validation, lacking systematic quantitative analysis.
sentences.zh: 然而，目前的研究主要集中在经验验证上，缺乏系统的定量分析。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose a framework linking PA with LLM unlearning.
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一个将PA与LLM遗忘联系起来的框架。

sentences.en: Through bi-level optimization, we first quantify how unlearning specific negative examples impacts PA performance.
sentences.zh: 通过双层优化，我们首先量化遗忘特定负示例对PA性能的影响。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that these effects vary substantially across negative examples.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析表明，这些效应在不同负示例之间存在显著差异。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we pose a crucial question: how can we optimally select and weight negative examples for unlearning to maximize PA performance?
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们提出了一个关键问题：如何最优地选择和加权用于遗忘的负示例，以最大化PA性能？

sentences.en: To answer this, we propose Unlearning to Align (U2A), which leverages bi-level optimization to efficiently select and unlearn examples for optimal PA performance.
sentences.zh: 为了回答这一问题，我们提出了Unlearning to Align（U2A），它利用双层优化高效地选择并遗忘示例，以实现最优的PA性能。

sentences.en: We validate the proposed method through extensive experiments, with results confirming its effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 我们通过大量实验验证了所提出的方法，结果证实了其有效性。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/U2A-9E75.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/U2A-9E75获取。

title_en: LFQ: Logit-aware Final-block Quantization for Boosting the Generation Quality of Low-Bit Quantized LLMs
title_zh: LFQ：逻辑感知的末块量化，用于提升低比特量化LLM的生成质量

sentences.en: As large language models continue to scale, low-bit weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical solution to their memory-efficient deployment.
sentences.zh: 随着大语言模型不断扩展规模，低比特的仅权重的训练后量化（PTQ）为其内存高效的部署提供了一种实用解决方案。

sentences.en: Although block-wise PTQ is capable of matching the full-precision (FP) baseline on basic language modeling and understanding, its quality is degraded for \textit{generative} tasks---especially at longer responses and extended chains of thought, which is critical in boosting task accuracy.
sentences.zh: 尽管逐块PTQ能够在基础语言建模和理解上与全精度（FP）基线匹敌，但它在\textit{generative}（生成）任务上的质量会下降---尤其是在较长的响应和扩展的思维链上，而这对提升任务准确度至关重要。

sentences.en: We attribute this shortfall to two factors: (i) the omission of the unembedding layer (the LM head) in block-wise optimization and (ii) the reliance on the mean squared error (MSE) objective.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一不足归因于两个因素：(i) 在逐块优化中遗漏了去嵌入层（LM头），以及 (ii) 对均方误差（MSE）目标的依赖。

sentences.en: Both factors cause the token probability distribution of the quantized model to misalign with that of the FP model, yielding notable accuracy drops on text generation benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 这两个因素都会导致量化模型的token概率分布与FP模型的分布错位，从而在文本生成基准上造成显著的准确度下降。

sentences.en: To rectify the discrepancy, we introduce \emph{Logit-aware Final-block Quantization (LFQ)}, a simple yet effective enhancement to block-wise PTQ that quantizes the final Transformer block by minimizing the cross-entropy between the logits of the FP model and those of its quantized counterpart.
sentences.zh: 为了纠正这一偏差，我们引入了\emph{Logit-aware Final-block Quantization (LFQ)}（逻辑感知的末块量化），一种简单而有效的逐块PTQ增强，它通过最小化FP模型与其量化对应物在logit上的交叉熵来量化最后一个Transformer块。

sentences.en: By aligning token probabilities at the logit level in the final block, LFQ consistently improves the accuracy of complex generation tasks over state-of-the-art block-wise PTQ across diverse model families, while maintaining parity with FP baselines on language modeling and understanding.
sentences.zh: 通过在末块中于logit层面对齐token概率，LFQ在多种模型家族上相对于最先进的逐块PTQ一致地提升了复杂生成任务的准确度，同时在语言建模和理解上与FP基线保持持平。

title_en: Lie-Algebraic Acceleration of Neural Koopman Dynamics
title_zh: 神经Koopman动力学的李代数加速

sentences.en: We present a Lie-algebraic approach to model Koopman dynamics that integrates algebraic structure with computational scalability.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种用于建模Koopman动力学的李代数方法，它整合了代数结构与计算可扩展性。

sentences.en: The proposed formulation constrains the neural generators to evolve within prescribed Lie subalgebras and constructs finite-time flows through a neural Magnus expansion construction, thereby maintaining consistency with the associated Lie-group composition over each time segment.
sentences.zh: 所提出的公式将神经生成器约束为在规定的李子代数内演化，并通过神经Magnus展开构造有限时间流，从而在每个时间段内保持与相关李群复合的一致性。

sentences.en: To address the computational burden inherent in sequential propagation, we exploit the associativity of Lie-group compositions and construct segmentwise propagators via a prefix-scan algorithm, which reduces the depth of temporal composition from linear to logarithmic.
sentences.zh: 为了解决顺序传播固有的计算负担，我们利用李群复合的结合性，通过前缀扫描算法构造逐段传播子，将时间复合的深度从线性降低到对数。

sentences.en: Consequently, the framework enables accurate long-horizon prediction while improving computational efficiency, and provides a principled foundation for scalable Koopman operator learning for nonlinear systems.
sentences.zh: 因此，该框架能够在提高计算效率的同时实现精确的长视界预测，并为非线性系统的可扩展Koopman算子学习提供了有原则的基础。

title_en: LieStoNet: Learning Lie Symmetries from Spatiotemporal Data for Stochastic Dynamical Systems
title_zh: LieStoNet：从时空数据学习随机动力系统的李对称

sentences.en: Symmetry is central to modern machine learning and physics: invariances and equivariances improve sample efficiency, robustness, and out-of-distribution generalization, while symmetry principles guide scientific modeling.
sentences.zh: 对称性在现代机器学习和物理学中处于核心地位：不变性和等变性提高了样本效率、鲁棒性和分布外泛化，而对称性原理则指导科学建模。

sentences.en: Yet for stochastic dynamical systems the relevant continuous symmetries are rarely known, and symmetry discovery for SDEs has remained essentially unexplored.
sentences.zh: 然而，对于随机动力系统，相关的连续对称性很少是已知的，而SDE的对称性发现基本上仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: We introduce *LieStoNet*, an end-to-end, template-free framework for discovering Lie-point symmetries of SDEs directly from spatiotemporal trajectories, without prespecifying symmetry groups, templates, or canonical coordinates.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 *LieStoNet*，一个端到端、无模板的框架，直接从时空轨迹中发现SDE的李点对称，无需预先指定对称群、模板或规范坐标。

sentences.en: Building on the seminal SDE Lie-symmetry theory of Gaeta and Quintero (1999), which formalizes Lie-point SDE symmetries and their relation to Fokker-Planck symmetries, LieStoNet learns neural surrogates for drift and diffusion from increments, then learns projectable generators by enforcing the SDE determining equations, separately regularizing for closure under Lie brackets, adherence to the Lie algebra axioms (bilinearity, antisymmetry, Jacobi), and a non-redundant independent basis.
sentences.zh: 它建立在Gaeta和Quintero（1999）开创性的SDE李对称理论上（该理论形式化了SDE李点对称及其与Fokker-Planck对称的关系），LieStoNet从增量中学习漂移和扩散的神经代理，然后通过强制满足SDE判定方程来学习可投影的生成元，并分别对李括号下的闭包、满足李代数公理（双线性、反对称、Jacobi恒等式）以及非冗余的独立基进行正则化。

sentences.en: The surrogate also defines an associated Fokker-Planck equation, enabling optional discovery of its Lie-point symmetries in parallel.
sentences.zh: 该代理还定义了一个关联的Fokker-Planck方程，从而能够并行地可选发现其李点对称。

sentences.en: Across multiple canonical SDEs with known analytic symmetries, LieStoNet recovers generators consistent with the ground-truth symmetry algebra, providing interpretable symmetry discovery for noisy dynamics.
sentences.zh: 在多个具有已知解析对称的典型SDE上，LieStoNet恢复出与真实对称代数一致的生成元，为含噪动力学提供可解释的对称性发现。

sentences.en: Code is available at this link.
sentences.zh: 代码可在本链接获取。

title_en: LieWarper: Geometry-Aware Motion Transfer via Lie Algebra
title_zh: LieWarper：通过李代数进行几何感知的运动迁移

sentences.en: Video motion transfer aims to synthesize novel content videos that strictly follow the motion trajectories of a reference video.
sentences.zh: 视频运动迁移旨在合成严格遵循参考视频运动轨迹的新内容视频。

sentences.en: However, existing methods typically operate in Euclidean space, treating motion as unconstrained pixel displacements or linear phase shifts.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常在欧氏空间中运作，将运动视为无约束的像素位移或线性相位平移。

sentences.en: This simplification frequently causes severe shearing artifacts and perspective collapse under complex camera and object motions.
sentences.zh: 这种简化在复杂的相机和物体运动下常常导致严重的剪切伪影和视角坍缩。

sentences.en: In this work, we present LieWarper, a geometry-aware motion transfer framework that reconceptualizes motion as coordinate evolution on a manifold rather than mere pixel displacement.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了LieWarper，一个几何感知的运动迁移框架，它将运动重新概念化为流形上的坐标演化，而非单纯的像素位移。

sentences.en: Specifically, we derive an analytic solver on the $\text{Sim}(2)$ manifold to extract global evolution parameters from noisy optical flow.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，我们在$\text{Sim}(2)$流形上推导出一个解析求解器，从含噪光流中提取全局演化参数。

sentences.en: We then introduce a flow-guided phase modulation mechanism, enabling non-rigid dynamics to undergo coordinate transformation along the evolution path.
sentences.zh: 然后我们引入一种流引导的相位调制机制，使非刚体动力学能够沿着演化路径进行坐标变换。

sentences.en: This approach achieves accurate trajectory transfer while maintaining global geometric integrity.
sentences.zh: 这种方法实现了准确的轨迹迁移，同时保持全局几何完整性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that LieWarper significantly outperforms state-of-the-art training-free baselines in both motion fidelity and geometric stability, while maintaining high generation quality.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，LieWarper在运动保真度和几何稳定性两方面都显著优于最先进的免训练基线，同时保持了较高的生成质量。

title_en: LIF Recurrent Memory Enables Long-Horizon Spiking Computation
title_zh: LIF循环记忆使长期脉冲计算成为可能

sentences.en: Processing long sequence data such as speech requires models to maintain long-term dependencies, which is challenging for recurrent spiking neural networks due to high temporal dynamics in neuron models that leak stored information in their membrane potentials, and due to vanishing gradients during backpropagation through time.
sentences.zh: 处理诸如语音之类的长序列数据需要模型保持长期依赖，这对循环脉冲神经网络而言具有挑战性，因为神经元模型中的高时间动态性会使存储在其膜电位中的信息泄漏，并且沿时间反向传播时会出现梯度消失。

sentences.en: These issues can be mitigated by employing more complex neuron designs, such as ALIF and TC-LIF, but these neuron-level solutions often incur high computational costs and complicate hardware implementation, undermining the efficiency advantages of spiking neural networks.
sentences.zh: 这些问题可以通过采用更复杂的神经元设计（如ALIF和TC-LIF）来缓解，但这类神经元级解决方案往往计算成本高昂并使硬件实现复杂化，削弱了脉冲神经网络的效率优势。

sentences.en: Here we propose an architectural-level solution that leverages the dynamical interactions of a few leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) neurons to enhance long-term information storage.
sentences.zh: 这里我们提出了一种架构级的解决方案，利用少数泄漏整合发放（LIF）神经元的动力学交互来增强长期信息存储。

sentences.en: The memory capability of this LIF-based micro-circuit is adaptively modulated by global recurrent connections of the recurrent spiking neural network, contributing to selective enhancement of temporal information retention, and promoting stable gradient propagation through time.
sentences.zh: 这种基于LIF的微电路的记忆能力由循环脉冲神经网络的全局循环连接自适应调节，从而有选择性地增强时间信息保留，并促进随时间稳定的梯度传播。

sentences.en: The proposed model outperforms baselines including LSTM, ALIF, and TC-LIF in long sequence tasks, achieving 96.52\% accuracy on the PS-MNIST dataset.
sentences.zh: 所提出的模型在长序列任务上优于包括LSTM、ALIF和TC-LIF在内的基线，在PS-MNIST数据集上达到了96.52\%的准确率。

sentences.en: Furthermore, our method also provides a compelling efficiency advantage, yielding up to 277$\times$ computational efficiency improvement compared to conventional models such as LSTM.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的方法还提供了令人信服的效率优势，与LSTM等传统模型相比，计算效率最高提升了277$\times$。

sentences.en: This work paves the way for building cost-effective, hardware-friendly, and interpretable spiking neural networks for long sequence modeling.
sentences.zh: 这项工作为构建经济高效、硬件友好且可解释的、用于长序列建模的脉冲神经网络铺平了道路。

title_en: LIFT: A Novel Framework for Enhancing Long-Context Understanding of LLMs via Long Input Fine-Tuning
title_zh: LIFT：一种通过长输入微调增强LLM长上下文理解的新颖框架

sentences.en: Long-context understanding remains challenging for LLMs due to limited context windows.
sentences.zh: 由于上下文窗口有限，长上下文理解对LLM而言仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: This paper introduces **Long Input Fine-Tuning (LIFT)**, a framework that improves the long-context performance of arbitrary short-context LLMs by dynamically adapting their parameters to each long input.
sentences.zh: 本文引入了 **长输入微调（LIFT）**，一个通过动态地将参数适配到每个长输入来提升任意短上下文LLM长上下文性能的框架。

sentences.en: Instead of endlessly extending context windows to fit longer inputs **in context**, LIFT stores and absorbs the input **in parameters**.
sentences.zh: LIFT不是无休止地扩展上下文窗口以在**上下文中**容纳更长的输入，而是将输入存储并吸收到**参数中**。

sentences.en: By fine-tuning long inputs into parameters, LIFT enables short-context LLMs to answer questions even when required information is absent from the inference context, avoiding the quadratic input-length complexity of standard long-context models.
sentences.zh: 通过将长输入微调到参数中，LIFT使得短上下文LLM即使推理上下文缺少所需信息也能回答问题，从而避免了标准长上下文模型与输入长度呈二次方关系的复杂度。

sentences.en: Rather than simple continued pretraining on new long contexts, LIFT uses carefully designed LLM-generated synthetic tasks to enhance comprehension beyond memorization.
sentences.zh: LIFT并非简单地在新的长上下文上进行继续预训练，而是使用精心设计的、由LLM生成的合成任务来增强超越记忆的理解能力。

sentences.en: To offset fine-tuning overhead, we design a highly optimized pipeline that reduces Time to First Token (TTFT) to under 10 seconds for 8k context.
sentences.zh: 为了抵消微调开销，我们设计了一个高度优化的流水线，将8k上下文的输出首个token时间（TTFT）降至10秒以内。

sentences.en: We further analyze LIFT's strengths and limitations, discuss large-scale deployment feasibility, and highlight future research directions.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步分析了LIFT的优势和局限性，讨论了大规模部署的可行性，并指出了未来的研究方向。

sentences.en: Implementation is open-sourced at [https://github.com/MuLabPKU/LIFT](https://github.com/MuLabPKU/LIFT).
sentences.zh: 实现已开源，见[https://github.com/MuLabPKU/LIFT](https://github.com/MuLabPKU/LIFT)。

title_en: Lifting Traces to Logic: Programmatic Skill Induction with Neuro-Symbolic Learning for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
title_zh: 将轨迹提升为逻辑：用于长视界智能体任务的神经符号学习程序化技能归纳

sentences.en: Foundation model-driven agents often struggle with long-horizon planning due to the transient nature of purely prompting-based reasoning.
sentences.zh: 由基础模型驱动的智能体常常因纯粹基于提示的推理的瞬时性而在长视界规划上步履维艰。

sentences.en: While existing skill induction methods mitigate this by distilling experience into state-blind parameterized scripts, they fail to capture the conditional logic required for robust execution in dynamic environments.
sentences.zh: 虽然现有的技能归纳方法通过将经验蒸馏为状态无关的参数化脚本来缓解这一问题，但它们在捕捉动态环境中稳健执行所需的条件逻辑方面仍有不足。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose Neuro-Symbolic Skill Induction (NSI), a framework that lifts interaction traces into modular, logic-grounded programs.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了神经符号技能归纳（NSI），一个将交互轨迹提升为模块化的、以逻辑为基础的程序的框架。

sentences.en: By synthesizing explicit control flows and dynamic variable binding, NSI empowers agents to discover when and why to act.
sentences.zh: 通过合成显式的控制流和动态变量绑定，NSI使智能体能够发现何时以及为何行动。

sentences.en: This paradigm enables the efficient generalization, allowing agents to induce skills from few-shot examples and flexibly adapt to unseen goals.
sentences.zh: 这种范式能够高效泛化，使智能体从少量示例中归纳技能，并灵活地适应未见的目标。

sentences.en: Experiments on a series of agentic tasks demonstrate that NSI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, empowering agents to self-evolve into architects of logic-grounded skills.
sentences.zh: 在一系列智能体任务上的实验表明，NSI一贯优于最先进的基线，使智能体能够自我进化为逻辑基础技能的架构师。

sentences.zh: 项目主页：https://sh-jj.github.io/NSI。

title_en: LiftQuant: Continuous Bit-Width Control for Pareto-Optimal LLM Deployment
title_zh: LiftQuant：面向帕累托最优LLM部署的连续位宽控制

sentences.en: Existing quantization methods are fundamentally limited by rigid, integer-based bit-widths (e.g., 2, 3-bit), creating a "deployment gap" where LLMs cannot be optimally fitted to specific memory budgets.
sentences.zh: 现有的量化方法从根本上受限于僵化的、基于整数的位宽（例如2、3比特），形成了“部署鸿沟”，即LLM无法被最优地适配到特定的内存预算。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce LiftQuant, a novel framework that enables continuous bit-width control for true Pareto-optimal deployment.
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了LiftQuant，一个实现了真正帕累托最优部署的连续位宽控制的新颖框架。

sentences.en: The core innovation is a "lift-then-project" mechanism: we represent d-dimensional weight vectors by projecting a simple 1-bit lattice from a tunable D-dimensional "lifted" space.
sentences.zh: 其核心创新是一种“先提升再投影”机制：我们通过从可调的D维“提升”空间中投影一个简单的1比特格，来表示d维权向量。

sentences.en: By adjusting the lifted dimension D, LiftQuant naturally yields an effective bit-width of D/d, allowing for seamless, continuous resolution adjustment rather than discrete steps.
sentences.zh: 通过调整提升的维度D，LiftQuant自然产生D/d的有效位宽，从而实现无缝、连续的精度调节而非离散的步进。

sentences.en: This projection generates a structured yet non-uniform codebook, capturing the expressive power of Vector Quantization.
sentences.zh: 这种投影会生成一个结构化的但非均匀的码本，捕捉向量量化的表达能力。

sentences.en: Crucially, its decoding path relies solely on linear transformations and 1-bit uniform quantizers, retaining hardware-friendly efficiency.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，其解码路径仅依赖线性变换和1比特均匀量化器，保留了硬件友好的效率。

sentences.en: This flexibility is transformative: LiftQuant enables a 70B LLM to be compressed to 2.4 bits to precisely fit a 24GB GPU, where its performance significantly surpasses state-of-the-art 2-bit models.
sentences.zh: 这种灵活性具有变革性：LiftQuant能够将70B的LLM压缩到2.4比特，以精确适配24GB GPU，而其性能显著超越了最先进的2比特模型。

sentences.en: With a decoding throughput up to 6.7x faster than FP16, LiftQuant redefines compression as a continuous optimization problem, paving the way for a new generation of hardware-aware LLM deployment.
sentences.zh: 凭借最高比FP16快6.7倍的解码吞吐量，LiftQuant将压缩重新定义为连续优化问题，为新一代硬件感知的LLM部署铺平了道路。

title_en: Light Forcing: Accelerating Autoregressive Video Diffusion via Sparse Attention
title_zh: Light Forcing：通过稀疏注意力加速自回归视频扩散

sentences.en: Advanced autoregressive (AR) video generation models have improved visual fidelity and interactivity, but the quadratic complexity of attention remains a primary bottleneck for efficient deployment.
sentences.zh: 先进的自回归（AR）视频生成模型提升了视觉保真度和交互性，但注意力的二次方复杂度仍是高效部署的主要瓶颈。

sentences.en: While existing sparse attention solutions have shown promise on bidirectional models, we identify that applying these solutions to AR models leads to considerable performance degradation for two reasons: isolated consideration of chunk generation and insufficient utilization of past informative context.
sentences.zh: 尽管现有稀疏注意力解决方案在双向模型上显示了前景，但我们发现将这些解决方案应用于AR模型会导致显著的性能下降，原因有二：对chunk生成的孤立考虑，以及对过去信息性上下文利用不足。

sentences.en: Motivated by these observations, we propose \textsc{Light Forcing}, the \textit{first} sparse attention solution tailored for AR video generation models.
sentences.zh: 基于这些观察，我们提出了\textsc{Light Forcing}，这是\textit{first}（首个）针对AR视频生成模型量身定制的稀疏注意力解决方案。

sentences.en: It incorporates a \textit{Chunk-Aware Growth} mechanism to quantitatively estimate the contribution of each chunk, which determines their sparsity allocation.
sentences.zh: 它引入了一种\textit{Chunk-Aware Growth}（块感知增长）机制，用于定量估计每个chunk的贡献，从而决定它们的稀疏度分配。

sentences.en: This progressive sparsity increase strategy enables the current chunk to inherit prior knowledge in earlier chunks during generation.
sentences.zh: 这种渐进式稀疏度增长策略使当前chunk能够在生成过程中继承更早chunk中的先验知识。

sentences.en: Additionally, we introduce a \textit{Hierarchical Sparse Attention} to capture informative historical and local context in a coarse-to-fine manner.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们引入了\textit{Hierarchical Sparse Attention}（层次化稀疏注意力），以由粗到细的方式捕捉信息性的历史和局部上下文。

sentences.en: Such two-level mask selection strategy (i.e., frame and block level) can adaptively handle diverse attention patterns.
sentences.zh: 这种两级掩码选择策略（即帧级和块级）能够自适应地处理多样的注意力模式。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing sparse attention in quality (e.g., 84.5 on VBench) and efficiency (e.g., $1.2{\sim}1.3\times$ end-to-end speedup).
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法在质量（例如VBench上84.5分）和效率（例如$1.2{\sim}1.3\times$端到端加速）上都优于现有的稀疏注意力。

sentences.en: Combined with other efficient solutions, \textsc{Light Forcing} further achieves a $2.0{\sim}3.0\times$ end-to-end speedup across diverse GPUs (e.g., 27.4\,FPS on RTX 5090 and 33.9\,FPS on H100).
sentences.zh: 与其他高效方案相结合，\textsc{Light Forcing}在多种GPU上进一步实现了$2.0{\sim}3.0\times$的端到端加速（例如RTX 5090上27.4\,FPS，H100上33.9\,FPS）。
